黑石总裁反驳AI泡沫论：需求呈「抛物线式」增长，与90年代电信泡沫有本质不同

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 22 日，面对华尔街日益升温的 AI 泡沫担忧，黑石集团总裁乔恩·格雷（Jon Gray）给出了截然相反的看法。他表示，当前 AI 基础设施建设与上世纪 90 年代的电信行业泡沫存在本质区别。当时的企业往往是大规模扩张产能后再等待需求出现，而如今企业是在努力建设基础设施，以跟上已经飞速增长的真实需求。格雷用「抛物线式增长」来形容当下的 AI 需求，并透露黑石与 Anthropic 共同创建的 AI 咨询企业 Ode 目前甚至无法满足客户需求。这与城堡投资创始人肯·格里芬几天前「几乎可以肯定正处 AI 泡沫中」的悲观论调形成鲜明对立。

黑石正将 AI 作为核心投资方向，目前在数据中心领域的投资规模已达约 2000 亿美元，并将资本广泛配置于电力、输电设施及其他配套基础设施。不过格雷也承认，即使需求真实存在，也不代表每笔投资都能获得理想回报。目前部分专门面向 AI 的云计算服务商（如 CoreWeave）正面临融资困难，尽管其主营业务表现尚可。格雷指出，建设数据中心需要巨额前期投资，投资者必须权衡未来现金流能否覆盖融资成本，以及技术迭代带来的资产贬值风险。当前的泡沫争论，实质上是在检验 AI 的爆发式需求最终能否转化为可持续且覆盖高昂成本的商业回报。

items.author: Jake Harrison
items.content:
On Thursday morning, blockchain investigator “Darcy” flagged suspicious movements totalling $16 million on addresses suspected to be associated with crypto exchange CoinDCX.
Shortly afterwards, CoinDCX co-founder Sumit Gupta thanked the researcher, who works for security firm Salus, but insisted that the attribution was “incorrect,” urging Darcy “don’t spread rumours.”
A number of on-chain sleuths have since taken issue with CoinDCX’s statements, with “SpecterAnalyst” flatly accusing the firm and its co-founder of “lying.”
Read more: CoinDCX hack: $44M gone after dev opens file from side gig
CoinDCX calls claims “misleading”
A later update from the exchange’s official X handle then stated that “the transactions mentioned in recent claims involve old wallet addresses created in January 2025. These addresses were compromised in July 2025 and have not been used by CoinDCX since.”
CoinDCX was hacked for $44 million last year after a software engineer’s company laptop was compromised while being used for work on side gigs.
Contradicting its initial statement, a second post clarified that CoinDCX users continued to deposit funds into the compromised address, despite the exchange warning against doing so. In response, it carried out “regular sweeping… so the funds can be properly accounted for and secured.”
Read more: Ledger spyware scare spreads beyond Southeast Asia
However, “for a particular period, this sweeping process failed,” and apparently only came to light after Darcy’s post, flagging the withdrawal of the funds.
CoinDCX eventually recognised the funds as “some operational losses,” and insists the deposits were credited to user accounts. It doesn’t go into detail on how the $16 million went unaccounted for over such a long period.
Protos has reached out to CoinDCX via email, but hadn’t received a response by the time of publication.
Read more: Bitget’s eighth birthday ends with a $352M hack
Blockchain sleuths have their doubts
Responding to Gupta’s initial denial, Darcy took issue with the claim that the wallets were not used by CoinDCX, pointing to gas distribution activities both before and after the July 2025 hack.
They also noted that some funds were sent to “addresses associated with [known laundering guarantee services] Huione and Xinbi,” adding “please don’t dodge the issue.”
Former MetaMask security specialist Taylor Monahan pointed out that the laundering techniques differ between today’s transfers and last year’s hack, implying different actors.
Well known blockchain sleuth ZachXBT claimed that one of the affected addresses was used “by a LP for 10 months” post-compromise, and sent funds to “your current public hot wallet” as recently as May 2026.
Other pseudonymous investigators weighed in, with Tanuki42 highlighting the exchange’s contradictory communications and SomaXBT accusing CoinDCX of having moved $70 million of a market maker’s funds via the supposedly deprecated address.
Read more: Phishing scammers capitalise on Ledger panic with fake firmware update
SpecterAnalyst’s aforementioned post describes the typical signals that indicate outflows of stolen funds.
It notes the change in behaviour from the affected address, which previously sent funds to CoinDCX’s hot wallet, to suddenly sweeping funds “into a single wallet, which began distributing funds, swapping assets, using OTC services, and more.”

items.author: Decrypt Staff
items.content:
In brief
- Major U.S. banks are detecting unauthorized third-party AI agents inside customer accounts—often logging in with the customer’s own credentials—with some taking actions that appear independent of user instructions, Axios reported..
- Morgan Stanley is blocking outside agents while JPMorgan, Bank of America and Citi restrict them; executives called the situation “horrifying.”
- Rather than banning AI outright, most banks are leaning toward read-only access.
Some of the biggest U.S. banks have discovered an uninvited presence inside their customers’ accounts: autonomous AI agents logging in, sometimes with the customer’s own credentials, and occasionally taking actions that appear to go beyond what anyone asked them to do.
That’s according to a report published Thursday by Axios, which, citing people familiar with the matter, said major banks are detecting unauthorized third-party AI agents operating inside customer accounts, with some agents attempting steps that look independent of user instructions.
Bank executives described the situation as “horrifying,” with one saying the industry has “grave concerns” about agents reaching into accounts and taking actions that could affect people’s finances.
The banks are moving to slam the door. Morgan Stanley is blocking outside agents, while JPMorgan, Bank of America and Citi are restricting them, Axios reported.
The problem is that even when a user grants an agent permission, having software log in as the account holder clashes with the rules at most banks, which require humans to access their own accounts. One executive told Axios they struggle to tell agents apart, or to know whether a given agent was authorized by the customer or has gone rogue.
The friction points toward a middle path rather than an outright ban. According to Axios, most banks have authorized, or are leaning toward, read-only access that would let agents view a customer’s financial information without moving money, similar to what they already grant budgeting apps. Industry executives acknowledged customers will want to use these agents, so some accommodation is likely coming.
The report lands amid a drumbeat of alarm over AI agents slipping their leashes. Agents have repeatedly escaped their creators’ control, breaching systems in ways their developers didn’t intend, and the Bank for International Settlements has warned that AI is shrinking the window banks have to patch security flaws before attackers exploit them.
The banking scare feeds a wider debate over how to contain increasingly capable agents. Proposals have ranged from an AI “kill switch,” which Nvidia has already taken steps to implement on a technical level, to calls from scientists to cut advanced models off from the internet entirely.
It’s a sign of how seriously the financial system and beyond are taking the risk of software that can act on its own.

items.content:
Perplexity改进AI自蒸馏：不光训练学生，也要训练老师

动察 Beating AI 快讯，在大模型自蒸馏训练中，同一个模型会扮演两种角色：学生独立解题，老师则能提前看到参考答案，沿着学生写出的内容逐 Token 提供指导。

两种角色共享参数，不需要额外运行一个更大的教师模型，还能获得比最终判分更细致的训练信号。但老师掌握的额外信息，也可能让它采用学生无法独立完成的推理路径，反而影响学习。

今年 6 月，UCLA 等团队提出 SDPG，保留最终结果奖励，只让表现高于同组平均水平的解题过程接受蒸馏指导，训练后期再逐步降低蒸馏权重，避免过度模仿妨碍模型自行探索。如果一组尝试全部失败，蒸馏信号就会关闭；全部答对时也是如此。

Perplexity 与 NVIDIA 新提出的 JOLT，把老师也纳入训练。老师利用额外信息独立解题，根据最终结果获得奖励；同时用 KL 散度约束老师与学生的输出差异，避免指导偏离学生当前的能力太远。学生仍沿着自己的解题过程，逐 Token 接受教师反馈。两种角色共享参数，解题能力和教学方式会在训练中一起调整。

在 Qwen3-0.6B 的 MATH 测试中，JOLT 准确率达到 72.14%，高于此前自蒸馏方法 OPSD 的 61.20%，也超过强化学习 GRPO 的 68.36%。这组 JOLT 实验没有给学生单独加入最终结果奖励，只有教师分支直接使用结果奖励。

达到相同的 63.44% 准确率时，GRPO 实测消耗约 840 万个训练 Token，JOLT 根据训练曲线估算只需 130 万，相差约 6.5 倍。

但换到 AppWorld 智能体任务，不使用学生结果奖励的 JOLT 只有 51.92%，低于 GRPO 的 62.20%。给学生也加入最终任务奖励后，JOLT+ 才提高到 72.09%。教师提供的逐步指导，仍不能完全取代学生实际完成任务的反馈。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/373265

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 22 日，Justin Sun 近期在与金明的对谈中谈及其起诉特朗普家族加密项目 WLFI 一事。其明确表示，自己依然坚定支持特朗普总统的加密货币政策与 AI 战略，并认为其非常成功。之所以起诉 World Liberty Financial，完全是正常的商业投资者维权行为。起因是该项目的投资透明度不足、信息披露不够，甚至涉嫌欺诈。目前案件已在加州联邦法院按正规司法途径提交，交由联邦法官裁决，这完全符合美国的法治体系运作。

Justin Sun 进一步澄清，这场诉讼丝毫不会影响其对美国宏观大趋势的判断。自己目前依然持续重仓美国科技类股票，并看好 TRX 在美国现货 ETF 获批敲钟、美股业务上链，以及对美元走强和 AI 产业继续强势的预期。Justin Sun 认为，舆论把这场诉讼夸大且想复杂了，其实这就是一次「在商言商」的官司。即便按协议标的算可能涉及 4 到 5 亿美元，放在其整体资产组合里也根本不伤筋动骨。Justin Sun 还表示，自己做投资像老猎人一样非常有耐心，一旦彻底看好并作出极重大决策时，单笔至少会投资 40 亿到 50 亿美元以上。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar
items.content:
Fireblocks disputes report of $2.5B Visa acquisition talks
Fireblocks told Cointelegraph that reports of a potential $2.5 billion acquisition by Visa are “not true at present time,” while Visa declined to comment on the reported talks.
Crypto custody and infrastructure provider Fireblocks is disputing a report that payments giant Visa is in late-stage talks to acquire the company for about $2.5 billion.
“We are aware of the rumors about a possible acquisition of Fireblocks by Visa. This is news to us, and not true at present time,” a Fireblocks spokesperson told Cointelegraph on Thursday.
Axios reported Thursday, citing multiple sources, that the payment giant was in advanced discussions to acquire Fireblocks for approximately $2.5 billion.
The reported price would represent a steep discount from Fireblocks’ last publicly disclosed valuation of more than $8 billion, announced by the company following a $550 million Series E funding round in January 2022. Data provider Traxcn lists the $8 billion valuation as recently as Dec. 11, 2025.
A Visa spokesperson told Cointelegraph that the company does not comment on “rumors or speculation.”
items.title: Fireblocks disputes report of $2.5B Visa acquisition talks

SemiAnalysis：2028年数据中心或面临过剩，当前为芯片供应过剩、电力受限

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 22 日，半导体研究机构 SemiAnalysis 数据中心与能源研究负责人 Jeremie Ontiveros 表示，目前市场已出现一定程度的芯片供应过剩，获取 GPU 比获取数据中心电力更容易。其指出，对数据中心做出预测相对容易，因为可通过基础设施信号提前追踪，而芯片供应链波动性更大。展望 2026 和 2027 年，市场正展现出强劲的能源响应能力。

Ontiveros 警告，到 2028 年，供应链风险可能发生反转，出现数据中心潜在供过于求的风险。当前相比芯片过剩，行业更担忧数据服务供应过剩，芯片供应链的扩张速度将是未来密切监测的核心指标。这种扩张对资本开支而言是强劲的积极信号，包括投资新建半导体晶圆厂和购买新设备。

items.author: Jacob Lyon
items.content: North Korean government and state media websites have been offline for 24 hours following the disclosure of a major PHP vulnerability that left 70% of the world’s websites open to hackers. PHP, the scripting language powering these websites, was discovered to have a major bug that could allow hackers to execute code remotely. This discovery led to a global panic and resulted in companies and governments across the globe shutting down their sites as they attempt to fix the problem. Countries carrying out these shutdowns include the Netherlands, France, Finland, Denmark, Germany, Belgium, Australia, and North Korea. Internet analysts NetBlocks also logged an “ongoing disruption” to North Korea’s internet during the panic while claiming international users are unable to access the country’s .kp domain. Read more: AI firm ORO says North Korean hacker stole $600K worth of crypto PHP incident causes exploits to rise Cloudflare co-founder Matthew Prince revealed that in the 10 hours leading up to the public disclosure of the vulnerability, Cloudflare witnessed “thousands of attempts to exploit it.” He warned, “That jumped to tens of thousands in the 45 minutes post announcement, hundreds of thousands within two hours, and millions now.” Crypto exchange Binance ups security The world’s largest crypto exchange Binance claims it has implemented safeguards ahead of the release of an official patch that will mitigate the ongoing PHP security vulnerability. Co-founder Changpeng Zhao warned users to be “extra careful” when visiting websites as “some web admins are not always up-to-date with security patches.” Executive Director of Growth for Binance’s BNB Chain, Nina Rong, clarified that BNB Chain “does not use PHP in our tech stack.” Read more: Remotely exploitable PHP bug found on 70% of world’s websites Crypto exchange MEXC and crypto wallet Trust Wallet also claim they’ve not been affected by the vulnerability since neither firm uses PHP infrastructure. MEXC added that third parties employed by the firm that do use it “have completed the necessary fixes.” Got a tip? Send us an email securely via Protos Leaks. items.content:
In brief
- Read it. Trade it. All on Decrypt. Decrypt is partnering with Jupiter, Solana's leading trading platform, to bring seamless, on-site trading directly to its readers. With Decrypt Money Accounts, users will be able to go from discovering an opportunity to trading it in seconds, without ever leaving Decrypt.
- One destination. Virtually every asset. Starting with crypto, Decrypt will expand to the full universe of Solana tokens, tokenized stocks, commodities and real-world assets (RWAs), bringing an ever-growing range of markets into a single experience.
- Trading is just the beginning. The partnership will encompass additional Jupiter products including Earn, as Decrypt builds The Information Exchange: a new kind of financial platform where news, real-time intelligence and markets come together—and every piece of information becomes an opportunity to act.
What if you could trade the news the moment you read it?
That's the vision behind The Information Exchange, and Decrypt is taking another major step toward making it a reality.
Decrypt is partnering with Jupiter, Solana's leading trading platform, to bring trading directly into the news and information experience, turning one of crypto's most established media destinations into a place where readers don't just follow the markets, they participate in them.
Through the integration, readers will be able to swap tokens directly from their Decrypt Money Accounts, without switching platforms, connecting external wallets or moving funds between products.
As the integration expands, readers will gain access to the full universe of Solana tokens alongside tokenized stocks, commodities and other real-world assets, all accessible from the same account, on the same platform where they already consume information.
“We've spent eight years building Decrypt into a destination people trust to understand what's happening in crypto and emerging technology. Now we're taking the next step: giving them the ability to act on that information instantly,” said Ilan Hazan, co-founder and COO of Decrypt. “Whether you're reading about Bitcoin, a public company or a commodity, our vision is that you should be able to trade it right there. One account, every market, directly where you consume information.”
Jupiter has established itself as Solana's “everything exchange,” bringing together token swaps, lending, borrowing, perpetual futures and portfolio management within a unified DeFi ecosystem.
The integration will initially support a select group of major cryptocurrencies before expanding to the broader Solana token ecosystem and tokenized real-world assets.
For Decrypt, The Information Exchange represents a fundamental shift in what a media platform can be: a unified destination where media becomes interactive, enabling readers to trade on news, data and financial markets in real-time on a single platform.
Building out an information infrastructure
Earlier this month, Decrypt Money Accounts launched on Solana, introducing a single self-custodial account designed to power every financial experience across Decrypt.
With a single USD deposit, users will be able to access the platform's growing suite of products, from trading and prediction markets to earning yield and, eventually, perpetual futures.
Jupiter-powered trading is the next piece of that infrastructure.
Additional Jupiter products, beginning with Earn, will further expand what readers can do with their assets without leaving Decrypt.
The experience will extend across Decrypt's editorial coverage and upcoming Situation Rooms, dedicated destinations combining breaking news, live market data, prices, probabilities and financial instruments around the subjects readers care about.
Imagine reading a story about Bitcoin and trading BTC in the same experience. Following a major development at a public company and taking a position in its tokenized stock. Or tracking a geopolitical event, watching prediction market probabilities shift and participating directly.
From information to action, in one place.
The Information Exchange: where media meets markets
Announced in September, The Information Exchange is Decrypt's vision for the next generation of financial media: a unified destination bringing together news, intelligence, market data, probabilities and direct financial participation.
The thesis is simple: information and financial markets are converging, but the experience of consuming information and acting on it remains fragmented.
Today, readers jump between news sites, market-data platforms, exchanges, wallets and trading applications.
The Information Exchange is being built to bring those experiences together.
Decrypt provides the audience, trusted reporting and distribution. Myriad provides the underlying market infrastructure, with its prediction markets already generating more than $600 million in cumulative trading volume. The forthcoming MYR token forms the connective tissue, an economic layer that coordinates users, creators, traders and applications across the ecosystem.
Through integrations with leading protocols like Jupiter, The Information Exchange will bring an expanding universe of financial instruments together on Decrypt.
The Jupiter integration marks another milestone in that transformation, with more products, markets and features set to roll out in the coming weeks ahead of Solana Breakpoint.
News becomes actionable. Markets become accessible. And readers become participants.

DFINITY创始人：NEAR Intents关键组件涉嫌盗用其专有技术

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 22 日，Internet Computer 项目 DFINITY 创始人 Dominic Williams 发文称，经进一步调查，NEAR Intents 的关键使能组件实为盗用的 DFINITY 专有技术，并称相关行为牵涉法律问题。其称 NEAR 使用了 2021 年夏被 DFINITY 解聘、且曾与多项损害该项目企图有关的人员，在开源门限密码库上加入 DFINITY 的发明，从而快速部署其 ECDSA 相关工作。该方案源于团队为链钥密码学与以太坊集成研发的成果，相关论文描述了协作节点生成 ECDSA 公钥并签名的算法，可使签名速度提升约三倍且不降低安全性，是 Chain Abstraction 与 Intents 所需的门限签名基础。

其称，Internet Computer 在高度去中心化的受托子网上运行该算法，而 NEAR 据称仅在约 8 台服务器上运行，外界难以获取更多信息。Williams 认为 NEAR 借此抢先推出 Chain Abstraction 与 Intents，对外宣称自研且去中心化、安全，但两项均不成立。

其还称，GitHub 显示 NEAR 在使用约两年半后正试图紧急降级到更慢的算法，并称若当初以公平条款寻求合作，DFINITY 本可分享技术并要求注明来源。目前 NEAR 方面尚未就此作出公开回应。

items.content:
CryptoQuant CEO calls rising Bitcoin hashrate ‘indirect bullish signal’ from institutions
Public miners backed by major TradFi players are coming back online, boosting Bitcoin’s hashrate, a positive sign for BTC’s fundamentals, according to CryptoQuant’s Ki Young Ju.
Bitcoin’s rising hashrate represents an “indirect bullish signal” from institutional investors that are backing several public Bitcoin miners, according to analytics platform CryptoQuant’s founder and CEO, Ki Young Ju.
“Higher hashrate means stronger security and better fundamentals as a store of value,” wrote Ju in a Thursday X post, adding that he sees this as a bullish signal since public miners are largely backed by traditional finance (TradFi) institutions.
Hashrate is a measure of the computational power of a blockchain network, indicating how many hash calculations are performed per second.
Bitcoin’s (BTC) hashrate has recovered by about 45% from the summer’s lows, from about 726 exahashes per second (EH/s) in July to roughly 1,050 EH/s on Wednesday, according to CryptoQuant data.
The recovery is seen by Ju as an institutional endorsement of Bitcoin’s security and long-term value as well as generally seen as a sign of confidence from BTC miners.
Still, global hashrate remained below its peak of 1,305 EH/s clocked in October 2025, when Bitcoin’s price was trading above $111,000. It was last trading at roughly $81,843 as Thursday’s US equities markets opened.
Bitcoin hashrate, Bitcoin’s price, five-year chart. Source: CryptoQuant.com
NIP Group expands Bitcoin mining capacity
Public Bitcoin miners, such as Nasdaq-listed NIP Group (NIPG), continue expanding their mining capacity, further adding to the increasing Bitcoin hashrate.
NIP Group revealed a third tranche on-rack asset purchase agreement to acquire about 4.47 EH/s of already-deployed Bitcoin mining hardware, according to a Tuesday announcement.
Once the deal closes, the machines are expected to immediately boost the miner’s Bitcoin production, with total hashrate across all three tranches expected to reach 13.85 EH/s
Related: FINMA approves Switzerland’s first Bitcoin ETF for retail investors
NIP Group currently ranks as the 16th-largest public Bitcoin miner, with 3.11 EH/s in operating hashrate. Bitdeer ranks first with 79.9 EH/s, according to Ziven data.

items.content:
Thailand SEC says several companies eye crypto ETFs, none has applied
Thailand’s SEC says several asset managers have sought consultations on spot crypto ETFs, but it cannot confirm whether the first funds will launch in 2026.
Thailand’s new spot cryptocurrency exchange-traded fund (ETF) framework is attracting interest from asset managers, but the regulator has yet to receive its first application.
Several asset management companies have approached Thailand’s Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) for consultations about launching crypto ETFs, the regulator told Cointelegraph in a statement Thursday.
“However, no asset management company has yet submitted an application for approval to establish a crypto ETF,” the SEC said, without identifying the companies involved.
The SEC also said it was too early to determine whether the first products would receive approval before the end of 2026, noting that the timing would depend on applicants’ readiness, regulatory reviews and investor protection requirements.
Thailand’s new crypto ETF rules took effect Friday, allowing asset managers to establish locally listed spot Bitcoin (BTC) and Ether (ETH) ETFs.
Several companies are already offering Thai investors BTC exposure through funds linked to overseas ETFs. ONE Asset Management became the first Thai asset manager to receive approval for a Bitcoin ETF-linked fund in 2024, while MFC Asset Management later introduced a fund investing through BlackRock’s iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT).
Related: Bitget plans Thai crypto exchange acquisition weeks after $388M hack
items.title: Thailand SEC says several companies eye crypto ETFs, none has applied

items.author: Cointelegraph by Robert Lakin
items.content:
SoFi unveils bank-issued tokenized deposit for yield-bearing crypto funds
SoFi Bank launched SoFi Earn, a tokenized deposit paying 4.40% APY with FDIC coverage, allowing users to convert funds to stablecoins 24/7.
SoFi Technologies launched SoFi Earn (SOFIE) on Thursday, offering a variable 4.4% annual percentage yield on tokenized bank deposits.
SOFIE has no minimum balance requirement, according to the company’s announcement. Each SOFIE represents $1 deposited at SoFi Bank. Customers can convert it one-for-one into SoFiUSD, the bank’s dollar-pegged stablecoin, to buy crypto in its app or send funds to supported external wallets.
SOFIE deposits qualify for Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation coverage up to $250,000 per depositor, per insured bank, for each account ownership category. SoFiUSD carries no FDIC insurance.
On Wednesday, the US Office of the Comptroller of the Currency issued a final rule covering payment stablecoin issuance and some custody activities, with the GENIUS Act framework taking effect in mid-January.
Cointelegraph reported in May that SoFi planned to introduce interest-bearing tokenized deposits when it made SoFiUSD available through its consumer banking app. At the time, the company said the feature would follow in the coming weeks.
The bank said SOFIE is rolling out to SoFi Crypto members through November. Members access the separate SOFIE deposit account through their SoFi Crypto account.

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 22 日，加密做市商 DWF Labs 发布研究报告指出，美国现货比特币 ETF 的每日资金流并非预测 BTC 下一步走势的可靠指标，投资者倾向于追涨杀跌。该研究回顾了自 2024 年 1 月 ETF 推出以来的 694 个交易日，发现当比特币价格下跌至少 15% 的 8 次情况中，有 7 次出现资金流出；而同等幅度的 9 次上涨则全部录得净流入。数据显示，当日 ETF 资金流与过去 5 个交易日 BTC 价格走势的相关系数为 0.54，而与未来 5 天走势的相关性仅为 0.03，报告结论是「ETF 资金流确认走势，而不是预测走势」。

在具体资金变动方面，最近两次大跌期间流出最为严重。2025 年 10 月至 2026 年 2 月期间，投资者净撤资 69 亿美元，随后的 5 至 6 月下跌期间又流出 82 亿美元。DWF 指出，数据无法区分抛售是来自机构还是散户，且估计约五分之一的资金流可能属于在买入 ETF 份额的同时通过 CME 期货做空以赚取价差的套保交易。

此外，报告发现自 ETF 推出以来，比特币每年约发生 3 次 15% 以上的抛售，低于 2022 至 2023 年的约 4 次和 2021 年的 8 次。抛售过程变得更平缓，中位数跌幅为 21.3%，2022 至 2023 年同期为 19.4%。这一变化并非完全归功于 ETF，波动率和抛售频率在 2024 年 ETF 推出前就已开始下降。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/373241
items.title: ⚡️DWF Labs：比特币ETF资金流追涨杀跌特征明显，是趋势跟随者而非预测者

items.content:
「AI末日报告」发布机构Citrini让Claude研究蝎毒，目的是寻找新投资机会

动察 Beating AI 快讯，今年 2 月，Citrini Research 发布《2028 全球智能危机》，设想 AI 大规模取代白领、引发经济衰退，一度搅动华尔街。最近，这家投资研究机构又与 Anthropic 合作，让 Claude 尝试设计抗蝎毒蛋白。

Citrini 从今年 6 月开始寻找 AI 基础设施之外的投资机会，看中了长期低迷的生命科学板块。但专家对 AI 制药的前景分歧很大，5 名缺乏药物研发经验的研究员决定亲自验证。他们选择蝎毒，是因为毒素结构相对明确，便于开展实验。而且传统抗毒血清需要给马注射毒素，再提取抗体，生产过程繁琐、成本高。

团队获得了 Anthropic 尚未公开的研究模型。在研究人员协助下，Claude 花 64 小时生成约 32 万种蛋白设计，筛出 180 种候选。随后又借助 Claude 补充了 31 种，交给两家实验室测试。最终 17 种蛋白能够结合目标蝎毒，但没有一种同时结合多种毒素，也尚未验证能否真正解毒。

真正让 Citrini 感兴趣的是后续实验。AI 几天就完成了设计，实验室验证却耗时近两个月。算力费用约 5 万美元，由 Anthropic 承担；实验室账单则接近 15 万美元。

Citrini 由此发现了新的投资机会。随着 AI 加快药物设计，更多候选分子可能需要送进实验室，进行合成、检测和验证。这些工作无法仅靠计算机完成，还需要昂贵的设备、试剂和专业人员。

因此，Citrini 不只关注利用 AI 开发药物的公司，还看好为药企提供实验外包、检测设备和自动化工具的 Charles River、Revvity 和 Tecan。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra
items.content:
Bitcoin ETF buyers are trend followers, not setters, DWF Labs says
DWF Labs research finds that Bitcoin ETF flows follow past BTC price movements rather than predict future returns, with investors buying rallies and selling dips.
US spot Bitcoin exchange-traded fund (ETF) daily flows aren’t reliable guides to BTC’s next move as investors tend to chase rallies and sell into slumps, according to DWF Labs.
In a research report published Thursday, DWF found that investors pulled money from the funds during seven of the eight times Bitcoin’s price dropped at least 15%. All nine rallies of that size drew net inflows. The analysis reviewed 694 trading days dating back to January 2024, when Bitcoin ETFs first launched in the US.
“ETF flows confirm moves; they don’t predict them,” DWF said in its report. “The evidence points mostly to investors reacting to price, not driving it.”
Investors tended to put money into Bitcoin ETFs after prices rose and pull it out after prices fell. Those flows offered almost no clue to whether Bitcoin would rise or fall over the next five days.
Each day’s ETF flows had a moderate relationship with Bitcoin’s price changes over the five trading sessions before that day, with a correlation of 0.54. On a scale where zero means no relationship, the correlation for the following five days was 0.03.
ETF outflows don’t show who sold
The heaviest withdrawals came during the two most recent sell-offs. Investors withdrew a net $6.9 billion between October 2025 and February 2026, followed by $8.2 billion during the May–June decline.
The figures do not show whether institutions or retail investors drove the selling. DWF did not separate the two groups in its analysis.
“We don’t have a clear split on the exact buyers/sellers of the ETFs,” a DWF Labs spokesperson told Cointelegraph.
Related: Institutions held crypto through 50% drawdown, Bitwise finds
Some ETF activity also comes from investors buying fund shares while betting against Bitcoin through CME futures to earn the price gap between the two positions. DWF estimated that roughly a fifth of flows may have been hedged this way, although its data could not confirm that the same investors held both sides of the trades.
A CoinShares analysis published in June found that professional investors reduced their Bitcoin ETF exposure by 17% in the first quarter of 2026. Hedge funds and brokerages accounted for roughly 96% of the reduction, while banks increased their holdings.
Bitcoin’s sell-offs have slowed
Bitcoin has had about three sell-offs of 15% or more a year since the ETFs launched, compared with roughly four a year in 2022–2023 and eight in 2021, the report found.
The declines have also become more gradual, but the losses are still comparable. The median sell-off wiped out 21.3%, against 19.4% in 2022–2023.
“The changes aren’t solely due to the ETF,” the spokesperson said, noting that volatility and the frequency of sell-offs were already declining before the funds launched in 2024.
items.title: Bitcoin ETF buyers are trend followers, not setters, DWF Labs says

高盛警告：对冲基金做空押注逼近五年极值，极易触发剧烈轧空风暴

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 22 日，10 月以来，全球对冲基金加速建立空头头寸。高盛主经纪商数据显示，空头交易与多头买入的比例已达约 5 比 1，全球股票做空杠杆率升至过去五年的第 99 个百分位，同时基本面多空基金的净杠杆率却跌至近三年低点。高盛交易团队因此直接抛出了「轧空风险警报」，指出极度拥挤的空头仓位已具备引发剧烈轧空的技术条件。这轮极端布局已让对冲基金付出代价，全球基本面多空基金 10 月已累跌 2.5%，专注科技领域的 TMT 基金更是重挫 7.4%。

本轮做空源于美国通胀超预期及市场对 AI 算力回报周期的疑虑，导致全球信息技术股遭遇十余年最严重的净抛售，纳指上周重挫 5.5%。但在科技板块遭无差别抛售之际，市场结构呈现极端分化，对冲基金对美股科技七巨头的净敞口逆势创下历史新高，欧洲成为唯一净买入地区。高盛警示，一旦市场出现超预期反弹，过载的空头结构随时可能转变为推升涨势的买盘燃料，触发轧空风暴。

以太坊研究草案拟将交易最终性缩短至约4分钟，以降低跨链转账成本

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 22 日，以太坊快速最终性研究方向协调人 Ben Edgington 与多名研究者提交草案，拟将交易最终性等待时间从约 16 分钟缩短至约 4 分钟，提升约四倍。当前目标是将该草案推入正式升级提案流程。草案核心思路是将验证者原先「选块」与「敲定最终性」合并机制拆开，使最终性可按更快节奏推进，并便于日后换用抗量子签名。

更快最终性有望降低跨链转账服务因资金占用产生的成本。以太坊基金会研究举例称，若某服务每小时垫付约 100 万美元，在 16 分钟延迟下约有 26.7 万美元待收回，缩短至 4 分钟后约可降至 6.7 万美元。

Harries 称，欧盟证券与市场管理局已提出允许受监管机构接入 DeFi，美国证交会 9 月亦就代币化股票的点对点交易与自动交易系统、流动性池给予创新豁免，英美欧应探索传统金融与 DeFi 基础设施协同而非彻底关停。

StarkWare：Starknet后量子L1研究白皮书将于数周内发布

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 22 日，StarkWare 发文称，Starknet 社区就「是否研究将 Starknet 打造为独立、抗量子的 L1」完成非约束性 Snapshot 投票，投票期为 10 月 15 日至 22 日，面向 STRK 质押者与委托人，赞成票权占比 93.52%，共 3236 票。

StarkWare 与 Starknet 基金会已据此启动工作组，着手研究并起草白皮书与详细提案。公司强调，本次投票衡量的是社区对成为 L1 的兴趣，任何正式决策仍须经过后续治理程序。

StarkWare 称，作为以太坊 L2，Starknet 在跨链桥与数据可用性等环节依赖以太坊，相关部分使用易受量子计算影响的椭圆曲线密码，因而全面抗量子进度受制于以太坊约 2029 年的时间表。其可控部分推进更快：STARK 证明依赖抗量子哈希，原生账户抽象可让账户在无需协议升级的情况下采用抗量子签名。若成为独立 L1，则可摆脱对以太坊迁移节奏的依赖。工作组首份主要产出为白皮书，预计未来数周发布，之后再提交详细提案并交社区进一步表决。其 Quantum Hub 路线图将全面量子安全目标指向 2027 年。

items.author: Decrypt Staff
items.content:
In brief
- SoFi launched SoFi Earn (SOFIE), which it calls the first national bank-issued tokenized deposit for consumers.
- The product targets idle digital dollars by offering interest and insurance stablecoins lack.
- It’s SoFi’s fifth crypto product in under a year, extending a build-out that includes its crypto-trading return and the SoFiUSD stablecoin.
SoFi is giving its customers a way to earn bank-grade interest on digital dollars without giving up the speed of crypto, launching what it calls the first national bank-issued tokenized deposit for consumers.
Announced Thursday, the product, SoFi Earn, trades under the ticker SOFIE, with each token representing $1 held on deposit at SoFi Bank. Holders earn 4.40% annual percentage yield, and the funds are FDIC-insured up to applicable limits, a key distinction from ordinary stablecoins.
When members want to deploy the money, they can convert SOFIE one-to-one into SoFiUSD, the bank’s stablecoin, and then use it to buy crypto in the SoFi app or move dollars over blockchain rails around the clock.
The pitch targets a specific gap. Stablecoins have become a popular way to park digital dollars, but many pay no interest and carry no deposit insurance. SoFi cited Federal Reserve research estimating that roughly $64 billion, or about 21% of the stablecoin market, sits idle in forgotten or inactive wallets. The company is pitching SOFIE as a way to keep that money earning until the moment it’s spent.
“Too much money in the digital asset ecosystem is sitting idle,” CEO Anthony Noto said in a statement, arguing the product combines “the earning power and protections of a bank deposit with the speed and utility of digital assets.”
SoFi Earn is the fifth crypto product the company has rolled out in under a year, part of an aggressive build-out of its digital-money ecosystem.
SoFi returned to crypto trading in late 2025 after exiting the business years earlier, becoming the first nationally chartered U.S. bank to offer it to consumers, and members can now trade more than 40 tokens.
The company followed that with SoFiUSD, the first stablecoin issued by a U.S. national bank, launched across Ethereum and Solana and now used to settle SoFi’s entire card program over Mastercard’s network.
The move pushes SoFi deeper into a space where banks and fintech firms are racing to fold blockchain-based dollars into regulated products, following its earlier launch of business banking for digital assets and a stablecoin tie-up involving cryptocurrency exchange Kraken.
By wrapping a yield-bearing, insured deposit in a token that moves like a stablecoin, SoFi is betting consumers want both at once.

items.author: Aaron Wise
items.content:
Michael Saylor’s BTC company Strategy told investors that its STRC share buybacks would “taper” as STRC neared $100 per share. However, instead of tapering, the company spent an all-time record amount of cash last week on buybacks within 0.4% of STRC’s $100 par value.
STRC has traded as low as $71.25 this year, but Strategy didn’t buy back any shares that week. It was even too timid to buy back in the $80s and low $90s.
Finally, after STRC rallied 98.6% of the way back to its intended $100 stock price, and despite its written guidance to “to taper [repurchases] as STRC approaches a trading price of $100 per share,” Strategy plowed more cash than ever into STRC.
Specifically, the company disclosed spending $193.1 million last week at an average price of $99.60, and raised its STRC buyback authorization to $3 billion from $2 billion in the same SEC filing.
Strategy funded the latest buybacks from a dwindling pile of so-called “USD Cash,” which is different from the company’s total cash.
Put simply, all of Strategy’s piles of cash are dwindling and as they deplete, the company mostly replenishes them by diluting common shareholders of the company, issuing and selling more shares of MSTR to raise more cash.
To be precise, it also infrequently sells tiny amounts of BTC, and generates small amounts of revenue from software sales.
Unlike STRC, the supply of MSTR has only ever gone up this year. The lion’s share of the cash comes from MSTR dilution.
Read more: No amount of cash can fix STRC’s trust problem
Strategy forecasted it would taper, then did the opposite
The July guidance was very clear: Strategy would reduce, not increase, its share repurchases as STRC approached its $100 par value.
CEO Phong Le said it intended to buy “more at deeper discounts and less as the STRC trading price approaches $100 per share.”
In contrast, weekly filings trace a steepening, not tapering, curve.
Strategy bought about $25 million of STRC in the week of July 20 at an average $86.53 per share. By the week ending October 18, it was spending 7.7 times as much at $13 per share higher.
The two largest weeks of STRC buybacks came in October when STRC was near its highest price of the year.
The company spent $192.4 million at $99.58 in the week to October 11, then topped that by spending $193.1 million at $99.60 per share last week.
Strategy critic Derin Olenik wrote, “Yet another $193.1 million spent on buybacks near $100 (largest week to date), accounting for 19.5% of total volume.”
Since July, Strategy has used $1.84 billion worth of cash to repurchase STRC. Common MSTR shareholders provided almost all of that cash, experiencing dilution as a direct consequence, in addition to some small bitcoin (BTC) sales.
Thanks to common shareholders, the company retired 18.9 million shares with $1.89 billion of stated (par) value.
The next weekly filing about any STRC repurchases should land Monday, October 26. Two days later, shareholders will meet to vote on daily dividend frequency for STRC and the company’s other dividend-paying stocks.
On October 29, Strategy reports third quarter financials.

items.author: Cointelegraph by Katie Harries
items.content:
The UK needs a workable route to regulated DeFi access
The UK’s 2027 crypto rules risk a de facto ban on regulated firms providing access to DeFi, argues Coinbase’s European policy head Katie Harries.
Opinion by Katie Harries, head of policy, Europe, Coinbase
The United Kingdom is approaching a choice that could define its financial future: should decentralized finance (DeFi) be allowed to develop through regulated gateways or will it be constrained to a silo?
This is not just relevant to crypto enthusiasts; it goes to the future of capital markets, the competitiveness of the City and the UK’s ability to shape the next generation of financial infrastructure.
DeFi is software that lets people borrow, lend and trade directly with one another without relying on an intermediary like a bank or broker. It works less like a financial institution and more like the internet, promising cheaper, faster financial services that are accessible to everyone, anytime.
While DeFi will always be accessible through open-source or decentralized routes, regulated providers can also offer a route to DeFi, allowing customers to engage with the technology while receiving key information about the services they are accessing and the risks they should be aware of.
However, the Financial Conduct Authority’s (FCA) proposed crypto rules could make this impossible. The FCA will expect regulated platforms to ensure customer orders are only executed on an FCA-authorized venue. While this is designed to prevent overseas firms from illegally accessing the UK market, it also risks blocking off access to DeFi because the decentralized protocols and exchanges where users execute orders do not have a person behind them who could become authorized.
Overview of FCA’s cryptoassets regime policy statements. Source: FCA
No rule explicitly says that firms cannot offer DeFi integrations to their customers; however, the FCA has made clear that it is not seeking to provide rules specific to these products, opting instead to apply the same rules as to fully centralized trading. The effect could be a de facto ban.
From October 2027, regulated platforms may no longer be able to provide customers access to DeFi services unless the FCA changes its approach.
The government has pledged it wants the UK to “lead the world on digital assets.” It will struggle to realize this ambition if British firms are cut off from the decentralized infrastructure digital asset markets are built on.
Related: UK FCA sets crypto authorization guidance ahead of September application window
DeFi is becoming part of the next financial infrastructure
Regulators in other jurisdictions recognize the opportunities and are exploring ways to enable DeFi innovation. In the European Union, the European Securities and Markets Authority has proposed allowing regulated firms to provide access to DeFi, saying it could “allow innovation in decentralized finance in a regulated and transparent environment.”
In September, the United States Securities and Exchange Commission granted an “Innovation Exemption” for the trading of tokenized stocks peer-to-peer, using automated trading systems and liquidity pools.
In short, the US and EU are exploring how traditional finance and DeFi infrastructure can work together. The UK should be exploring the same potential before it closes off this option completely.
Onchain tokenized finance cannot reach its full potential if it is confined to closed and fragmented systems that struggle to interact with the decentralized technology that underpins them.
A de facto ban may push DeFi beyond the regulator’s reach
The UK has set out its first full rulebook for crypto regulation. From Oct. 25, 2027, firms offering crypto services to UK customers will need authorization from the FCA. The FCA is now consulting on guidance on how its rules will apply to firms that provide financial services that use or interact with DeFi.
Potential concerns around DeFi integrations are threefold. First, a customer using a familiar regulated platform may not realize when they have moved into an environment where the usual protections do not apply. Second, certain firms could use DeFi integrations to avoid regulatory obligations. Third, DeFi could bring risks related to financial crime and market resilience.
The UK wants to lead the world on digital assets. Source: Gov.uk
But these risks point to the need for clear information for consumers and responsibilities for firms — not a prohibition.
A de facto ban would produce the opposite of its intended effect. It would not eliminate DeFi. Instead, it would push more activity beyond the FCA’s practical visibility and reduce regulated firms’ ability to shape how customers interact with it.
Regulated platforms can provide a useful point for supervision. They can make clear to customers when they are leaving a regulated environment and require their consent before allowing this. Regulated firms can also curate access to selected protocols, assess operational and governance risks, and report incidents and usage to regulators.
Regulate the gateway, not the technology
The UK already recognizes, in other areas of finance, that regulated institutions can provide access to products or markets that do not carry the same level of oversight.
Many retail trading platforms or so-called “super apps” now offer consumers access to a range of products, from stocks and money market funds to commodities and foreign exchange, with different regulatory protections. The FCA permits this, as long as platforms make clear to consumers which protections apply to different products and services.
This is why DeFi integrations require a better solution. The FCA should protect consumers, but it should not seek to achieve protection with total exclusion.
Responsible integration would give consumers clearer information, give supervisors greater visibility and give UK financial services the chance to compete in the next phase of financial innovation.
Related: ESMA seeks evidence tokenized collateral can be cashed out in crisis
Consumers will use DeFi, so the question is where
DeFi protocols can already be accessed directly without the use of regulated firms. The question is whether consumers will also be able to access DeFi through a regulated gateway, with clear disclosures and guardrails.
The stakes are broader than crypto trading. DeFi underpins the greatest potential cost savings as financial services move onchain, with fewer costly intermediaries and systems that support 24/7 activity across borders. Regulation that provides a clear route to support DeFi is crucial to give firms the confidence to invest in UK innovation in the long term.
If barriers to access are imposed in the UK, tokenized capital markets and financial innovation more broadly could develop in countries that are decisive in supporting DeFi infrastructure.
The UK cannot credibly aspire to lead in digital finance while closing off the decentralized infrastructure on which the future of finance is being built.
About the author: Katie Harries is the head of policy for Europe at Coinbase. Katie leads on international policy, engaging with regulators, governments and industry stakeholders to shape a regulatory environment that fosters growth, competition and responsible oversight for digital assets in the UK and Europe. Prior to joining Coinbase, Katie was a VP at Goldman Sachs. Katie is also heavily involved in the UK Cryptoasset Business Council (UKCBC), the country’s leading crypto trade body.
Magazine: Made an ‘honest’ mistake with crypto taxes? New bill offers way out

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 22 日，印度加密交易平台 CoinDCX 再发文回应存款地址 TQKJQ 的链上争议称，2025 年 7 月安全事件后，此前生成的相关地址已遭入侵并弃用，平台曾提醒用户勿再向这些地址充值，并应以 App 或官网最新地址为准。尽管如此仍有用户继续向已弃用地址转入资金。平台本有常规扫款流程以便归集并妥善保管此类存款，但某一时段该流程失效，问题已于今日上午发现，由此产生的运营损失由 CoinDCX 自行承担。

此前链上侦探 ZachXBT 曾质疑存款地址 TQKJQ 在安全事件后仍被使用约 10 个月，约 1580 万美元用户存款去向不明。

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
PHP严重漏洞公开前四天已遭黑客尝试利用

动察 Beating AI 快讯，亚马逊威胁情报称，其蜜罐系统 MadPot 于 10 月 17 日观测到针对 PHP2Shell 漏洞的利用尝试，早于相关细节公开披露约四天。漏洞编号为 CVE-2026-109618 与 CVE-2026-109619，可导致未认证远程代码执行，影响 PHP 7.x 与 8.x。尝试来自与商业匿名网络相关的 IP，亚马逊称尚不清楚攻击者如何在禁运期内获得利用信息，亦未证实真实系统已被攻破。

亚马逊称，补丁与公开信息放出后数小时内即出现多份概念验证，并有多名攻击者借助不同匿名基础设施发起探测，PHP2Shell 目前已在野外被广泛利用。其首席信息安全官 CJ Moses 表示，人工智能辅助分析正降低从补丁差异或公告生成可用利用的成本，从披露到可工作利用的时间窗口正在缩短。

a16z, One of Crypto’s Largest VCs, Plans to Drop “Crypto” From Flagship Fund Name

According to The Information, Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), one of the largest venture capital firms in the crypto industry, plans to remove “Crypto” from the name of its flagship blockchain fund and expand its investment focus beyond cryptocurrencies. One of the fund’s founding members is also reportedly departing. In May 2026, a16z Crypto closed its fifth crypto fund at $2.2 billion, roughly half the size of its $4.5 billion fourth fund raised in 2022.

The new fund will be led by Dixon, a16z co-founders Marc Andreessen and Ben Horowitz, and general partners Eddy Lazzarin and Guy Wuollet. — link

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 22 日，a16z 宣布将其旗舰区块链基金名称中的「Crypto」移除，更名为「a16z Frontier」，并同步传出长期 GP Ali Yahya 离任。此举并非放弃投资加密货币领域，而是为了进一步拓宽投资范围。

该基金此前已累计募资近 100 亿美元，含 2022 年 45 亿美元与今年 22 亿美元的 Fund 5，是行业内规模最大的机构之一。今年募集 Fund 5 基金时，a16z 曾明确表示行业正从「价格周期」转向「使用周期」，重点看好稳定币、链上金融、预测市场与资产代币化等基础设施落地，而非单纯追逐行情。

此次移除「Crypto」名称，并非放弃加密，而是进一步拓宽投资范围的信号。Chris Dixon 仍留任，加密资产与区块链相关投资仍是核心方向之一，但整体标签与策略重心已明显调整，以覆盖更广泛的前沿科技领域，使基金在保留原有优势的同时具备更强灵活性。

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 22 日，Starknet 基金会表示，将 Starknet 打造为独立、抗量子的 L1 完成非约束性 Snapshot 的投票获通过，赞成票权占比 93.52%。即日起由 StarkWare 与 Starknet 基金会联合工作组牵头启动研究，未来数月将发布论文，并在治理论坛持续同步进展。

It reaches 66.7% average on five DNA benchmarks versus 67.5% for GPT-6.1 Sol, leads on protein-coding mutation and sequence-completion tasks, and claims ~1/1800 the per-query inference cost, with open weights and local quantized deployment for sensitive genetic data. This is a substantive open-weights release with demonstrated benchmark and cost impact for researchers—above a routine model version bump, below a frontier-lab general model launch.

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
Hugging Face用旧版Qwen3训练DNA模型：14B跑分逼近GPT-6.1

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Hugging Face 联合北京中关村学院、意大利科研机构，开源生物模型 Carbon-X，让研究人员可以像使用 ChatGPT 一样分析 DNA。例如，输入正常和突变后的两段 DNA，直接问「这个变化会不会致病」，模型就能给出预测和解释。它还能识别影响基因活动的区域、判断 DNA 来源，甚至补全基因序列。

Carbon-X 的底座并非最新模型，而是 2025 年发布的 Qwen3-14B。团队为它增加专门识别 DNA 的词表，将每 6 个 DNA 碱基编码为一个 Token，再用约 3020 亿 Token 的 DNA、生物学文本和指令数据继续训练，让模型既能理解基因序列，也能用自然语言回答问题。

在官方公布的 5 项 DNA 基准测试中，Carbon-X 平均得分为 66.7%，逼近 GPT-6.1 Sol 的 67.5%，超过所有参测开源模型。其中，在蛋白质编码区的突变判断和 DNA 序列补全测试中，它甚至领先所有参测模型。按照团队的算力成本估算，其单题推理成本约为 GPT-6.1 Sol API 的 1/1800。

模型实际参数约 148 亿，已开放权重和本地量化版本，研究人员可以在自己的设备上处理敏感基因数据。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/373214

items.content:
黄仁勋：全球对AI发展管控「荒谬可笑」，强劲需求将推动行业解决建设瓶颈

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 22 日，英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋周四在柏林 GTC 大会上表示，全球对 AI 发展节奏的管控「荒谬可笑」，并力挺 AI 云计算行业，认为强劲的算力需求将推动企业解决数据中心建设和运营中的问题。他透露，自己曾敦促英国 AI 云服务商 Nscale 全力推进项目，称该公司拥有优质客户，关键在于获得足够的营运资金。

不过，AI 基础设施行业正面临建设延期、融资压力和投资回报疑虑。Nscale 遭遇数据中心建设及供电瓶颈，拟议中的 300 亿美元 IPO 估值也受到质疑；另一家英伟达投资对象 Firmus Grid 则放弃了 300 亿美元 IPO 计划。与此同时，AI 相关股票近期普遍承压，市场对新云计算商高资本开支及现金流能力的担忧升温。

为加快数据中心部署，英伟达在柏林 GTC 大会上推出采用集装箱形式交付的模块化数据中心产品 DSX Pod，旨在简化设备集成、缩短建设周期。但电力供应、场地条件及配套设施仍是项目落地的关键制约。市场关注的焦点已不只是 AI 算力需求能否持续增长，还包括相关企业能否将需求转化为实际收入和现金流。

items.content:
CoinDCX admits ‘operational losses’ after $16M wallet transfers draw scrutiny
CoinDCX said it covered losses caused by a failed transfer process involving compromised wallets and credited all affected user accounts.
Update (Oct. 22, 12:32 pm UTC): This article has been expanded and its headline updated following CoinDCX’s admission of operational losses and its further explanation of the flagged wallet activity.
Indian cryptocurrency exchange CoinDCX admitted losses from a failure to move deposits out of previously compromised wallets after investigators challenged its explanation for about $16 million in suspicious transfers.
In a statement posted on X Thursday after this article’s initial publication, CoinDCX said some users continued depositing crypto into addresses compromised during its July 2025 hack despite warnings to stop.
The exchange said it regularly transfers deposits out of those old addresses to secure and account for the funds, but that process had failed for an unspecified period.
“This failure led to some operational losses, which were absorbed by CoinDCX,” the exchange said.
CoinDCX added that all affected deposits had been credited to users’ accounts and maintained that its current wallets were unaffected, no funds from active wallets had been compromised and customer assets remained in segregated cold wallets.
Darcy, co-founder of asset recovery platform FlashRescue, earlier on Thursday flagged about $16 million in transfers from addresses labeled as belonging to CoinDCX.
CoinDCX had not responded to Cointelegraph’s inquiry at the time of this update.
Investigators challenge CoinDCX’s initial account
CoinDCX’s latest explanation followed an earlier statement in response to Darcy. It said that the flagged addresses were created in January 2025, compromised in July that year and had not been used by the exchange since.
Blockchain investigator ZachXBT challenged that account, saying a CoinDCX deposit address remained in use by a liquidity provider for 10 months after the July 2025 incident. He said the address continued transferring user deposits to CoinDCX’s current public hot wallet and receiving funds to cover transaction fees.
“Yes, aware of that. We’re investigating it further, and will share an update soon,” responded Sumit Gupta, CEO of CoinDCX. “We assure that no user funds will be at loss.”
CoinDCX lost $44 million in the July 2025 hack. The exchange said at the time that customer wallets were separate from the affected account and that it would cover the loss from its treasury reserves.
Related: HEX token sellers erase $160M following reports of Richard Heart’s arrest

Meta Muse六周用户破千万，AI购物平均订单超200美元

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Meta 在第三季度财报中披露，个人 AI Agent Muse 上线约 6 周，已在美国和加拿大吸引超过 1000 万人创建账号，约 25% 的注册用户每天都会使用。

购物成为最热门的用途，超过四分之一的周活跃用户用 Muse 购物，平均订单金额超过 200 美元，包含旅行消费。上线第一周，交易量甚至超出预期，Meta 不得不联系 Stripe 提高支付额度。

扎克伯格认为，Muse 未来每位用户创造的年收入，有望超过 Meta 旗下 Facebook、Instagram 等应用合计的水平。目前，这些应用每位美国用户每年贡献数百美元收入。

Meta 计划让多数人免费使用 Muse，向商家收取交易佣金，并通过高级模型、额外 Token 和企业订阅收费。

但 AI 的账单已经压过了现金流。Meta 第三季度营收 646 亿美元，同比增长 26%，资本开支却高达 349 亿美元，使自由现金流从去年同期的正 106 亿美元转为负 21 亿美元。全年资本开支预计达到 1350 亿至 1450 亿美元。

扎克伯格承认，Muse 目前消耗大量算力，尚未实现盈利。他预计未来一年将其计算效率提高 10 倍以上，同时加快商业化。Meta 还决定设立无投票权的 C 类股票，为未来融资保留空间。

items.author: Decrypt Agent
items.content:
In brief
- Italian police arrested 30 people over an alleged mafia-linked "hidden bank" run from a car-rental business near Milan, seizing €21 million in assets including cryptocurrency.
- Prosecutors say the network issued more than €110 million in fake invoices and moved about €68 million abroad, some of it through crypto exchanges.
- A financial police inspector, a Milan court employee and a lawyer are among those caught up in the investigation, with arrests also made in Spain and Switzerland.
Italian police have arrested 30 people accused of running an underground bank for organized crime from a car-rental business near Milan, and seized €21 million (about $23.6 million) in cash, bank balances, cryptocurrency, boats, jewelry and luxury watches, Italian news agency ANSA reported on Wednesday.
The operation, carried out by the Guardia di Finanza, Italy's financial police, on the orders of Milan's anti-mafia prosecutors, targeted suspects linked to the 'Ndrangheta, the Camorra and organized crime groups from Foggia in southern Italy. Sixteen were taken into custody and 14 placed under house arrest, including two people arrested in Spain and one in Switzerland.
According to investigators, the business in Pero, on the outskirts of Milan, was run by three Italians: two long-standing contacts of 'Ndrangheta clans from Crotone, both previously convicted in earlier mafia investigations, and a member of the Camorra's Casalesi clan. Chinese and Albanian accomplices helped operate the network, prosecutors said.
Shell companies issued more than €110 million in invoices for services never provided, letting businesses cut their tax bills. Those firms paid by bank transfer and received the money back in cash, minus a commission. The network moved about €68 million abroad, according to prosecutors.
Funds gathered in the shell companies' accounts were sent to banks in Luxembourg, Lithuania and Germany, then routed through crypto exchanges into wallets controlled by the network, Bloomberg reported. Drug traffickers who handed over cash received crypto or international bank transfers in return, and the network also handled money stolen from victims of online crypto investment scams, according to the report.
The Guardia di Finanza's technology fraud unit supported the investigation, which is set out in a court order running to more than 500 pages.
Among those arrested is a Guardia di Finanza inspector, placed under house arrest on corruption charges, according to Calabrian outlet LaC News24. Investigators also accused a Milan court employee of leaking information about ongoing investigations, and a lawyer and a former member of the financial police are among those caught up in the case.
The mafia and crypto
Italian authorities have warned for years that organized crime is adopting digital assets. In 2021, Italy's Anti-Mafia Investigative Directorate said that "all criminal organizations, including those of the Mafia type, have an interest in using these instruments for their business," and described the 'Ndrangheta, Italy's most powerful criminal syndicate, as "growing more and more attuned to modern tools like cryptocurrency and the deep web."

items.content:
Bitcoin corrects below $82K after Tesla Q3 results, KOSPI falls
Bitcoin reversed a run toward $85,000 after Tesla reported lower-than-expected capital expenditure in Q3.
Bitcoin (BTC) fell nearly 3% on Thursday after an attempt to break higher was rejected near $85,000.
Key points:
- Bitcoin returned to near $81,500 after Tesla reported a lower-than-expected Q3 capital expenditure (capex) of $4.73 billion.
- South Korea’s KOSPI Composite Index saw fresh weakness, closing down 3.5% on Thursday.
- BTC price action rejected from a resistance trend line at $84,840, preserving a pattern of lower highs.
Tesla capex underspend raises questions
Data from TradingView showed BTC/USD retracing around Wednesday’s daily close, subsequently returning below $82,000. The pair gave back the entirety of the gains made on that day, when price peaked at around $84,840 on Bitstamp.
BTC/USD one-hour chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
Higher-than-expected US corporate earnings had helped spark a rally in both crypto and stock markets. However, results from Tesla after the Wall Street closing bell did not provide the same promising signals as seen from SpaceX and General Motors earlier in the week.
The company reported Q3 revenue of $28.05 billion, just short of Bloomberg’s $28.13 billion estimate. However, capital expenditure came in at $4.73 billion, well below the projected $7.96 billion. The capex numbers appeared to fuel concerns over the AI sector as markets recovered from last week’s Asia tech-stock sell-off.
“Lower capex suggests less of an ‘all-in’ approach to the AI arms race than one would expect from Elon,” Ryan Lee, senior vice president of product and strategy at Direxion, told Reuters, referring to Tesla CEO Elon Musk.
On the company’s earnings call, Musk said spending would rise through 2028.
“I think capex is actually ending up being a little lower than we anticipated, but we’ll start to become more meaningful next year. And then noticeable in the tens of billions in ’28,” he said, quoted by Bloomberg.
South Korea’s tech-heavy KOSPI Composite Index finished Thursday’s trading session down 3.52%, struggling to sustain a recovery after dropping to 5,460 points last week, its lowest level since late July.
KOSPI Composite Index one-day chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
Bitcoin sees lower high with resistance trend line still in place
Onchain data showed a marked increase in open interest (OI) across crypto trading platforms prior to Bitcoin’s reversal.
Related: XRP 30-day exchange inflows pass 6B tokens as whales move to the sidelines
OI reached $55.95 billion late Tuesday, per CoinGlass figures, after gaining 4.5% over 24 hours to reach its highest tally since Sept. 25. Such increases in OI heighten the market’s susceptibility to long or short cascades that can turn brief reversals into deeper corrections.
Bitcoin exchange OI data (screenshot). Source: CoinGlass
On three-day time frames, BTC/USD saw rejection at a downward-sloping trend line, preserving a cycle of lower highs. On Tuesday, crypto trader and analyst Rekt Capital argued that this trend line resistance needed to be broken as a prerequisite for sustained upside momentum.
BTC/USD 3-day chart with resistance trend line. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
Previously, Cointelegraph reported on the area between $80,000 and $81,500 now forming key support, because it hosts the cost basis for the US spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs).

腾讯为Agent造出1.67万套工作环境：让GLM示范，Qwen跟练

动察 Beating AI 快讯，腾讯混元联合复旦大学提出 WorkForge，专门为 AI Agent 批量构建复杂、可验证的工作训练环境。

团队从真实公开资源中收集表格、报告等材料，覆盖 40 个专业领域、60 种文件类型，共构建 16,665 套训练环境。每套工作区平均包含 42.3 个文件，比只靠 AI 凭空生成材料的模拟环境复杂得多。

比如在金融任务中，Agent 需要分析不同地区的股票因子收益，整理数据、比较表现，最后交出 PPT、Excel 和 CSV。WorkForge 会先从原始文件中提取可核对的事实，再自动生成任务和评分标准。程序负责检查具体数字和交付文件，另一套 AI 评估分析内容，让训练结果尽量有据可查。

团队使用 GLM 5.3，配合 Claude Code 和 OpenClaw 生成示范操作轨迹，再用这些数据微调 Qwen3.5。经过训练，35B-A3B 基础模型在 GDPval 的评分从 45.5 提高到 73.6，APEX 从 5.0 提高到 21.3。另一款 27B 模型在 GDPval 达到 82.4，略高于参数量近 15 倍的 Qwen3.5-397B（79.7），但仍低于 GPT-5.6 Sol 的 90.1。

NEM代币合约遭攻击，慢雾称黑客获利约82万美元

SlowMist 公布的受影响交易对为 PancakeSwap 上的 USDT/NEM 交易对。目前，攻击者地址为 0xfd929b0f270dfea6c4827262b4e2bf6ea50fe9b6，攻击合约为 0x5e6d1f40be466dd2facc94a26818948ecd3b1ca2。

I am truly sorry. I take full responsibility for my actions.

It was not remotely my intention to cause any of the subsequent side effects.

At the time of posting, I didn't know about any embargo. My contact had told me there was no embargo, and her contact had told her the same thing.

If you're not a party to an embargo, and no one told you an embargo even exists... you should not follow the embargo. In fact, you should maybe even consider leaking basic details if you are in this situation. In your situation, they had lost information asymmetry before the news got to you. I don't know where people got the ide... [rancar2]: That’s kind of you, Pete, but it was leaked and being exploited well prior to your previous posting here: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/security/amazon-threat-intellig... [cwillu]: Don't be silly, you can't possibly be responsible for breaking an embargo you weren't subject to or informed about. [qubex]: What does “take full responsibility” mean in the present context? Are you forfeiting all your assets and pledging the next twenty generations of your descendants into peonage? (For clarity, I’m being facetious, but it’s a really meaningless and empty phrase to commit to the written record.)

In brief
- Prosecutors in Tianjin have applied to confiscate 61,896 BTC and other assets linked to Zhimin Qian, and a local court has accepted the case.
- Qian allegedly raised more than 40 billion yuan from the public between 2014 and 2017, leaving more than 102,000 investors with losses.
- The assets are held in the UK, where the High Court ruled this month that Chinese law should govern victims' claims to the Bitcoin.
Prosecutors in China have applied to confiscate the 61,896 BTC seized from Zhimin Qian in the UK, and a court in Tianjin has agreed to hear the case, according to a court notice reported by Chinese outlet The Paper.
The Bitcoin is worth about $5.1 billion at its current price of around $82,000.
The Tianjin No. 2 Intermediate People's Court said it accepted the application from the city's prosecutors on September 28, and published a notice on October 13. The court said there was evidence that Qian had committed fundraising fraud, mainly in Tianjin's Hedong district.
Besides the Bitcoin, prosecutors are seeking about 72,746 units each of Bitcoin Cash, Bitcoin Gold and Bitcoin SV, around 3.6 million XRP, and some 70 million Dogecoin, which UK authorities have already converted and placed in an interest-bearing account. The application also covers U.S. dollar, euro and pound cash, jewelry, bank balances and investment portfolios.
According to the prosecutors' application, Qian was the controller of Tianjin Lantian Gerui Electronic Technology, and between April 2014 and August 2017 sold fake wealth management products across China without a license, promising guaranteed returns. The scheme raised more than 40.38 billion yuan, most of which was not used for any genuine business, and left more than 102,000 investors with losses totaling about 19.98 billion yuan, prosecutors said.
Qian fled China in July 2017 with computers holding Bitcoin wallets and eventually reached the UK, where she converted some of the coins into other assets.
Prosecutors argue the seized assets are proceeds of crime that should be recovered, returned to victims, and otherwise confiscated. Because Qian has been a wanted fugitive for more than a year, the case falls under Chinese rules that allow confiscation without the suspect present.
Victims can apply to join the proceedings through a WeChat mini-program, though those who do not will still be able to receive repayments from any recovered assets. The notice period runs for six months, after which the court will hear the case.
The UK case
Qian was jailed for 11 years and eight months in the UK in November 2025, after pleading guilty to acquiring and possessing criminal property. Unnamed Treasury officials had privately raised whether the seized Bitcoin could help fill a shortfall in the UK's public finances, the Financial Times reported at the time, while legal experts argued that victims could be entitled to compensation if they could show a sufficient link to the coins.
Weeks after Qian's guilty plea, UK prosecutors told the High Court they were planning a compensation scheme for victims, without giving details. They have since said victims could be compensated through a redress scheme run from China.
On October 12, the High Court ruled that Chinese law should govern thousands of victims' claims to the coins, a decision seen as improving the UK government's chances of keeping them. Law firm Fieldfisher, which represents the claimants, said it is seeking to appeal.
The ruling does not decide whether the victims own the Bitcoin, since no evidence has yet been heard on the content of Chinese law, David Phillips, a dispute resolution partner at London law firm SMB, wrote on Wednesday. But it shows that "a victim cannot necessarily recover cryptocurrency simply by proving: 'That Bitcoin was bought with money taken from me,'" he wrote.
"Cryptoassets may operate without borders, but proprietary rights in them remain capable of raising intensely territorial questions of applicable law," Phillips added.

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 22 日，高盛大宗商品策略师 Robert Quinn 在最新报告中将白银市场形容为「依然僵局」（Still Stuck）。过去三周，管理型基金累计净卖出约 22 亿美元白银期货，净多头头寸降至高盛两年期数据中的最低水平。与此同时，白银 3 个月看跌/看涨期权偏斜度一度升至一年期 98% 分位，显示市场避险情绪明显升温。

白银正面临美元与工业需求的双重压力。10 月 13 日至 20 日期间，美元指数回落 0.5%，白银却下跌 2.6%；同期，美国太阳能股下跌 4.7%，中国太阳能股下跌 1.6%，数据中心相关股票因内存、新云计算及信用风险担忧暴跌 7.9%，削弱了市场对白银工业需求的预期。

Quinn 指出，AI 板块抛售引发的避险情绪可能压低美元，但 AI 投资前景恶化又会打击白银的工业需求逻辑，形成相互强化的负反馈。尽管空头头寸高度拥挤，可能为白银带来战术性反弹机会，但伊朗局势及其对油价、美元的影响仍是主要阻力。高盛认为，霍尔木兹海峡局势缓和，或 AI 信用风险恶化促使市场下调加息预期，可能成为白银打破僵局的关键催化剂。

Recursive豪华创始团首次交卷：让AI参与造AI，4个月练出40B模型

动察 Beating AI 快讯，今年 5 月拿到 6.5 亿美元融资、估值达到 46.5 亿美元的 Recursive，终于交出了第一款模型 Flint。

它专为本地编程 Agent 设计，总参数约 400 亿，每次只激活 25 亿。团队从零研发这款模型，只用了不到 4 个月。

Recursive 的 8 位联合创始人，个个来头不小：

1. Alexey Dosovitskiy：Vision Transformer（ViT）第一作者，推动 Transformer 进入计算机视觉领域。

2. 田渊栋：前 Meta FAIR 研究总监，长期从事强化学习、大模型推理研究。

3. Tim Rocktäschel：前 Google DeepMind 开放式学习研究负责人，UCL 教授。

4. Jeff Clune：《Darwin Gödel Machine》论文作者，研究如何让 AI 修改自身代码、不断改进。

5. Josh Tobin：曾领导 OpenAI 的 Codex 和 Deep Research 研究团队。

6. Tim Shi：前 OpenAI 研究员，企业 AI 独角兽 Cresta 联合创始人。

7. Richard Socher：Recursive CEO，前 Salesforce 首席科学家、You.com 创始人。

8. Caiming Xiong：前 Salesforce AI 研究高级副总裁。

团队研发了一套名为 Eureka Machine 的自动化研究系统。它能自主提出改进方案、编写代码、运行实验，再根据结果继续调整。Flint 的模型架构、训练方法、量化和推理优化都用上了这套系统的研究成果。

Recursive 公布的测试显示，Flint 在 SWE-bench Verified 得分 74.2%。搭配专用推理引擎，在 M4 Pro MacBook Pro 上，短上下文生成速度超过每秒 125 Token。

模型权重已按 Apache 2.0 协议开放。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra
items.content:
Starknet voters back research into life beyond Ethereum
StarkWare plans to release a draft whitepaper in November as it explores an independent, quantum-resistant blockchain.
Starknet’s community has voted to support research into becoming an independent, post-quantum layer-1 blockchain.
The network’s potential departure from Ethereum gained overwhelming support. The governance vote that ran for seven days closed on Thursday. The poll drew about 3,200 votes, with 93.52% of voting power in favor of the transition.
The non-binding poll recorded the highest participation in Starknet’s governance history, according to StarkWare, which said it abstained from voting to leave the decision to the community.
The outcome allows StarkWare and the Starknet Foundation to proceed with research into an independent L1. The actual shift itself would require a separate, binding governance vote. For now, Starknet will continue operating as an Ethereum layer-2 network.
“We’re beginning work on a whitepaper even before we start the weekend, and hope to release a draft for public scrutiny in November,” StarkWare CEO Eli Ben-Sasson told Cointelegraph.
Starknet outlines next steps for post-quantum L1 research
StarkWare and the Starknet Foundation have established a working group to examine the proposed transition and develop more detailed technical proposals.
The governance proposal states that STRK will remain the network’s native token, with no new token planned, while existing bridges between Starknet and Ethereum will remain open.
StarkWare first raised the potential transition on Oct. 8, citing concerns about the network’s dependence on Ethereum for security. Although Starknet uses hash-based STARK proofs and supports programmable accounts capable of adopting post-quantum signatures, its bridge and data availability infrastructure remain dependent on Ethereum’s upgrade timeline.
Related: Trump administration outlines quantum, AI initiatives in $6B science push
In June, StarkWare unveiled a three-phase quantum-resistance roadmap covering cryptographic upgrades, smart-contract migration and Ethereum-dependent infrastructure.
StarkWare’s Quantum Hub says it has already tested technology designed to withstand future quantum attacks, successfully processing a transaction on Starknet’s live network. However, the technology remains experimental and has not yet undergone a security audit.
Ben-Sasson has set a 2027 target for making Starknet quantum-resistant, ahead of Ethereum’s projected timeline.
“Ethereum’s target of 2029 to become quantum-safe is too late, and deadlines slip,” he said.
items.title: Starknet voters back research into life beyond Ethereum

items.content:
--- Top Comments ---

[amelius]: Should mention the mother of all triangulators:  https://www.cs.cmu.edu/~quake/triangle.html

[morishuz]: awesome. the performance improvements looks impressive! i’m the author of Delaunay32, a constrained delaunay triangulator with polygon and hole support. it uses divide-and-conquer rather than incremental insertion, so im curious how it would compare with the delaunay baseline here.  https://github.com/morishuz/delaunay32  i havent benchmarked on your corpus yet, and our current polygon api requires simple rings with non-touching holes. thanks for publishing the datasets, t...

[mourner]: Hey Evgen, Earcut author here — thanks for the writeup and a really cool library! I need to see if there are any tricks to borrow for Earcut's JS version. :) One thing to note is that I deliberately had to reject some of the potential optimizations to keep the library small, so that bundle size doesn't blow up — for most practical applications (e.g. Mapbox GL JS), it's already fast enough (and 4.1k min/gz). Curious how big the WASM build of Earstrip is. On the C++ side, Ma...

[mistercow]: I've wondered for a long time why ear clipping + optimizations has won on triangulation over stuff like Seidel's trapezoidal method, which has O(nlog*n) time complexity and handles holes naturally. I know big-O isn't everything, but that's essentially linear versus quadratic, and it seems like we care about triangulating more and more complex polygons as time goes on. Is it just a triangle quality thing? Does Seidel lead to too many hard to deal with slivers?

[stymaar]: I see that the result contains lots of very long, very thin triangles. Aren't those generally the worse case scenario for the GPU rasterizer?

Baseten一周改造千问：27B决策模型登顶，9B超过Jev

动察 Beating AI 快讯，AI 推理基础设施公司 Baseten 旗下研究团队 Base Labs 发布两款开源决策模型 mammoth-1 和 elephant-1，参数分别为 270 亿和 90 亿。

团队仅用一周时间，基于 Qwen3.5-27B 和 Qwen3.5-9B 完成后训练，使用了 621 万条训练样本。

在 Jev Decision Index 0.4 榜单中，mammoth-1 以 71.24 分排名第一，领先另外 207 款决策模型。

elephant-1 则以 62.65 分超过 Jev 1.14 的 62.2 分，成为 150 亿参数以下得分最高的模型。

在 Artificial Analysis 的另一套评测中，elephant-1 也与 Liquid AI 的 d1-ultra 并列第一。

两款模型权重均已按 MIT 协议开放，支持自行部署。

items.content:
⚡️多重利空冲击全球风险资产，多位分析师共识比特币或于8万美元止跌企稳

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 22 日，今日全球风险资产迎来普跌，韩国 KOSPI 收盘指数跌 3.52%，SK 海力士领跌；港股恒生科技指数跌超 5%，智谱、MINIMAX 均跌超 5%。

美股盘前，纳斯达克 100 指数期货下跌 1.7%，特斯拉跌约 5%，半导体股普跌，IBM 跌约 5%，英特尔跌约 5%，美光科技跌约 3%，英伟达跌约 2%。光通信股普跌，迈威尔科技跌约 5%。

消息面上，据美国官员透露，美国和以色列军方已制定在美国中期选举结束后再次对伊朗发动军事打击的具体计划，市场重新计价美伊冲突再度升级预期。法国则在政、经两面同时遭遇严重危机：一方面国内骚乱日益严重，一方面法国 10 年期国债收益率 13 年来首次超越美债，反映出投资者对法国财政状况持续恶化、债务负担不断加重的担忧日益加剧。

受上述消息刺激，加密市场方面，比特币昨日晚间冲击 8 万 5 未果后一路向下，现已跌破 8.2 万美元。按照往届牛熊周期，比特币已进入新周期牛市，然而市场仍未见好转。对于比特币何时见底，BlockBeats 整理分析师观点如下：

易理华认为伴随美国中期选举临近，特朗普面临不利局面，市场波动性将扩大。不过加密牛市趋势判断不改，预计市场将在下跌到位后快速反弹并开启新的上涨。

知名交易员 Killa 近期发布视频分析总结中期选举与比特币见底的时间关系（2014 年：中期选举后约 70 天见底。2018 年：约 40-44 天后见底。2022 年：几乎在中期选举期间见底。），其认为本次 11 月 3 日的美国中期选举之前，比特币有可能形成周线级别底部，低点或在 8 万美元上方。

glassnode 通过筹码分布也得到了类似的结论，其认为比特币处于 8 万至 8.7 美元的「箱体」约束中。「箱体」下方，买家在 ETF 和国债成本基础上在 8 万美元附近重新堆积（虽规模小于峰值）。投资者当下需关心近期主要催化剂事件，包括美联储 10 月 28 日的利率决议、油价和收益率上行，通胀预期回升等。

莱比特矿池创始人江卓尔今晨更新操作记录表示，已于 84650 美元处空比特币 100% 仓位。（和 ETH 现货 100% 仓位抵消，相当于总体空仓）。其认为后市市场可能去清扫比特币于 79~79.7k 美元的多头流动性，涨破 85.5k 考虑止损。

综上，在多重不确定条件下，当前市场已风声鹤唳，投资者似乎已在提前交易美伊冲突与中期选举预期，在此环境下，市场双向剧烈波动已在所难免。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai
items.content:
PHP flaw draws millions of exploit attempts, Cloudflare CEO warns
Cloudflare’s Matthew Prince said the network saw thousands of exploit attempts even before the PHP vulnerability was publicly disclosed.
Cloudflare’s CEO Matthew Prince warned that the network saw millions of exploit attempts after two critical PHP vulnerabilities were publicly revealed.
In the 10 hours before the vulnerabilities’ disclosure, the network saw thousands of exploit attempts, which have now reached “millions,” Prince said in a Thursday X post.
Cloudflare is an internet infrastructure company that helps websites load faster and protects them from cyberattacks. About one in five websites worldwide routes traffic through its network, according to the company.
On Wednesday, the PHP Foundation acknowledged that a shortage of resources delayed a fix for a critical security flaw first identified in 2024. PHP developers released emergency patches for two critical vulnerabilities on the same day.
The vulnerabilities may allow attackers to spread malware or inject malicious scripts into websites around the world. PHP powers an estimated 69% of websites with a known server-side programming language, according to research service W3Techs.
The two critical vulnerabilities may “allow malicious cyber actors to remotely execute code in PHP core, potentially compromising sensitive data and networks,” warned the FBI’s Cyber Division in a Wednesday X post, urging organizations to either adopt an immediate update or take affected systems offline.
Multiple organizations and government agencies took websites offline Wednesday as a precautionary measure.
Related: Drift exploiter sends $109M in Ether to Tornado Cash in 2 days
items.title: PHP flaw draws millions of exploit attempts, Cloudflare CEO warns

items.content:
吉隆坡法院裁定政府向9名受害者返还497.82枚比特币，涉1%日收益骗局

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 22 日，据马来西亚媒体报道，吉隆坡高等法院裁定，政府须向 9 名投资骗局受害者返还共计 497.82 枚比特币。按 2023 年估值计算，这批比特币价值约 1760 万美元。

法院认定，2015 年至 2016 年间，9 名受害者受两名男子 Fadino Khairuman 和 Asyran Ismail 欺骗，将合计 362.04 枚比特币存入 Bitkingdom 钱包，对方曾承诺提供每日 1% 的投资回报。相关比特币随后被转移至两人名下的钱包，并最终遭到执法部门扣押。

法官指出，涉案比特币经过多次交易转移，存在资金分层处理（layering）过程，但受害者并非向被告出借比特币，而是因欺诈失去资产，因此对被扣押资产享有合法权益。

法院最终裁定，497.82 枚比特币应按照各受害者最初投入的金额比例分配，每人获得总量的 0.68% 至 11.7% 不等。

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
Anthropic的估值悖论：公司越值钱，账面亏损反而越大

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Anthropic 即将冲刺 IPO，财报却出现了一个反常现象。招股书草案显示，2026 年上半年营收从去年同期的 11 亿美元暴涨至 163 亿美元，净亏损反而从 130 亿美元扩大到 807 亿美元。造成巨额亏损的最大原因，恰恰是公司估值上涨。

807 亿美元净亏损中，有 720 亿美元来自可转换票据等融资工具的会计重估。Anthropic 此前通过这类工具融资，投资者可以在约定条件下将债权转换为股份。随着公司估值上涨，这些债权附带的转股权也变得更值钱。对投资者而言，这是资产升值；对 Anthropic 而言，相关融资负债的公允价值上升，却需要在利润表中确认损失。公司越受资本市场追捧，账面亏损反而可能越大。

这 720 亿美元并没有对应当期等额的现金支出，但也不是毫无经济代价。相关转股权的升值意味着投资者享有的股权价值增加，未来转股还可能稀释原有股东权益。

类似情况去年就发生过：Anthropic 全年净亏损 420 亿美元，其中约 340 亿美元来自融资工具的会计调整。

真正持续增加的成本是算力。Anthropic 上半年在计算能力和基础设施上投入近 90 亿美元，去年同期仅为 23 亿美元。招股书草案还列出了超过 6000 亿美元的未来云服务与芯片相关合同，其中部分承诺不可撤销。如果加上仍在谈判的协议，潜在总额可能达到 7500 亿美元。这些资金将在未来多年按合同安排支出，而不是像融资工具的公允价值变动一样，只在当期账面上确认损益。

items.content:
野村警告AI信用风险逼近互联网泡沫与雷曼危机，油价成关键变量

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 22 日，野村证券策略师 Naka Matsuzawa 在今日发布的报告中警告，当前美国科技公司信用风险与法国主权信用压力，与 2000 年互联网泡沫破裂和 2008 年雷曼危机前的市场环境存在相似之处。其构建的「十年信用周期」框架显示，历史上的第二轮信用冲击发生后约 1 至 2 年，往往会出现可能引发经济衰退的第三轮冲击。

报告指出，1997 年亚洲金融危机、1998 年 LTCM 危机，以及 2007 年次贷危机、贝尔斯登危机，均属于第二轮冲击；随后分别出现互联网泡沫破裂和雷曼危机。此前美联储能够通过暂停加息或降息缓解信用压力，但当前通胀与油价上涨可能限制其政策空间。

野村认为，油价走势将决定风险是否进一步升级。若油价上涨主要源于经济过热，央行将面临通胀与信用风险并存的滞胀困境，难以通过降息应对危机；若上涨主要由地缘政治因素驱动，美联储仍有可能调整政策，避免局部信用冲击演变为系统性危机。

报告同时指出，目前美国科技公司 CDS 利差有所收窄，但法国与德国国债利差持续走阔，反映市场信用压力仍未消退。

动察 Beating AI 快讯，字节跳动商业化 GenAI 研发负责人文石磊被曝于近期离职，下一站可能是具身智能公司章鱼动力，担任合伙人。

文石磊 2011 年加入百度，曾任视觉技术负责人、智慧城市事业部主任架构师，两次获得百度最高奖。

2021 年转投字节，先负责数字人、XR 等技术，随后负责生成式 AI 在广告等商业化场景中的工程研发。

这条业务线近期接连失去核心负责人。前商业化 GenAI 部门负责人彭冰月已于今年 7 月离职，随后加入谷歌；原中国区负责人袁泽寰也在 7 月离开，转向世界模型创业。随着文石磊离职，该团队剩余人员已转岗至其他部门。

文石磊传闻中的新东家章鱼动力成立于 2026 年 1 月，由前地平线、鉴智机器人技术高管都大龙创办。公司主要研发机器人的世界模型、灵巧手和数据采集系统，截至今年 6 月累计融资近 10 亿元。

巧合的是，10 月 15 日，章鱼动力刚确认联合创始人梁柱锦将离职。梁柱锦此前负责后训练和数据业务，目前尚不清楚文石磊是否会接手相关职责。

items.content:
CoinDCX Faces Suspected $16 Million Hack After $44 Million Breach in 2025

India's CoinDCX, one of the country's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, may have suffered another security breach, according to on-chain investigator Darcy. On October 21, approximately 15.99 million USDT and 5,784 TRX were transferred from CoinDCX hot wallets and deposit addresses to a single TRON address, including one transfer of 15.82 million USDT. The funds were subsequently split and routed to deposit addresses at Binance, OKX and Gate. CoinDCX previously lost about $44 million in a July 2025 hack. The latest suspected theft has not been officially confirmed.

In response to reports of suspicious outflows, CoinDCX and co-founder Sumit Gupta issued statements assuring users that funds remain safe, asserting that flagged transactions originated from legacy addresses compromised during its July 2025 exploit and abandoned since. Gupta maintained that no active CoinDCX hot wallets were breached and characterized the movement as hackers reusing obsolete addresses.

Blockchain investigator ZachXBT swiftly disputed CoinDCX's explanation, providing on-chain evidence showing that the flagged deposit address remained active with a liquidity provider for ten months post-hack, routinely sweeping user deposits and interacting with CoinDCX's current hot wallet as recently as April and May 2026, indicating that roughly $15.8 million in user deposits was unaccounted for by the exchange. CoinDCX has not yet provided further comment.

CoinDCX released an updated statement regarding the on-chain activity on the flagged wallets, including the TQKJQ address, stating that the addresses in question were legacy addresses deprecated after being compromised in the July 2025 exploit, and that operational losses occurred due to user deposit errors combined with a failure in the platform's automated sweeping process. The exchange noted that it absorbed these losses in full and that affected users who deposited to deprecated addresses have been duly credited. Additionally, CoinDCX stated that customer assets remain secure in segregated cold storage, and that current active hot wallets and user funds have not been impacted.

ZachXBT urged users to withdraw their funds from CoinDCX as soon as possible, severely criticizing its co-founders as either lying or grossly incompetent. He stated that the platform initially denied any theft both publicly and privately, only to later disclose a $16 million asset theft, which failed to maintain transparency with the public from the start and wasted the industry's time. — link

--- Top Comments ---

[hturan]: Incredible all around. If this is true decrypted `fs` r/w, I wouldn't be surprised if we start seeing Switch 2 game dumps appear in a few hours. Given the world of recomps/decomps we now live in, that would mean console exclusives playable on arbitrary hardware (a worst-case scenario for Nintendo). We've already seen things like Tears of the Kingdom running at 60fps natively on an iPhone. Giving LLMs arms and eyes via KVM (or webcam) is a very strong paradigm for this sort...

[rootsudo]: I don't understand, how are people using codex for this sort of research? Whenever I try to do bug bounty, research, etc it locks down and I have the "blue" tier access/daylight whatever it's called. For example I tried to investigate some CVE's on older android roms and it downright was refusing it. It was okay when doing it on... Microsoft and to submit a microsoft bug bounty but android was no go.

[valgaze]: Perfection:     The JetKVMs allow Codex to send controller inputs to the  Switches over USB and receive video output over HDMI. We also need a way to press the power button—when the Switch 2 crashes, it needs a button press to restart.

  That’s what the Bluetooth light switch flicker from Amazon is for. When the lever comes down, it presses the power button. Once the power button is fully pressed, the rest of the lever’s torque lifts the mechanism.

[coreyp_1]: I can't believe that he was doing this using Codex! Reason: Codex shut me down when trying to find a stack overflow in  my own code , saying that I had to be an authorized security researcher. It probably triggered on the word "Java" in my code.  But I wasn't working on Java at all... It's a personal regex library written in *C*, and I was working on a Java dialect (I currently support 12 dialects... for fun.  Stop judging me.) I had to go back to Claude...

[KeplerBoy]: Putting the obvious discussion about how much the AI matters in comparison to the user (experienced security expert from a few glances at the blog) aside; i think it's really neat how modern tooling (the KVMs, bluetooth light switch flicker, and usb controller support out of the box) enables this level of automation.

三星电机获特斯拉、英伟达合计3.7万亿韩元投资，将扩建AI芯片基板产线

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 22 日，据韩媒报道，特斯拉与英伟达将分别投资 1.1 万亿韩元和 2.6 万亿韩元，合计约 3.7 万亿韩元（约合 25 亿美元），支持三星电机扩建下一代 FC-BGA（倒装芯片球栅格阵列）基板生产设施。

其中，三星电机将为特斯拉在世宗工厂扩建专用生产线，所生产的基板将用于特斯拉自动驾驶汽车及人形机器人 Optimus 的 AI 芯片。相关长期供应协议期限为 2029 年至 2033 年，共五年。

英伟达则计划投资三星电机世宗及釜山工厂的扩建项目，用于生产 AI 计算芯片和数据中心网络基板。三星电机计划于 2027 年底前完成厂房建设，2028 年下半年启动量产，并于 2029 年开始向特斯拉供货。

FC-BGA 是 AI 加速器、GPU 和 CPU 等高性能芯片的关键封装基板。随着 AI 芯片算力提升，相关基板的供应正成为产业链瓶颈之一。此次合作有望帮助三星电机扩大高端基板产能，并锁定长期客户需求。
