意大利打击加密洗钱网络，涉嫌向境外转移6800万欧元

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 21 日，据彭博社报道，米兰检方表示，意大利当局正对 30 名涉嫌运营黑手党关联地下银行的人员展开逮捕行动。该网络涉嫌向境外转移约 6800 万欧元，并利用加密货币清洗非法资金。行动延伸至西班牙，当地警方正在执行欧洲逮捕令，瑞士当局也正寻求拘捕另一名嫌疑人。

检方称，该网络以米兰附近一家汽车租赁公司为据点，通过空壳公司开具虚假服务发票，帮助建筑、物流等行业的涉案企业减少应税收入。企业通过银行转账付款后，该网络扣除佣金，再以现金返还资金。

空壳公司账户内的资金被转至卢森堡、立陶宛及德国的银行，再通过加密交易所进入涉嫌由该组织控制的数字钱包。调查人员识别出逾 1.1 亿欧元虚假发票，并发现该网络还处理了贩毒所得及线上加密投资诈骗受害者被骗资金。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/373007

《绝地求生》厂商开源30B模型：修Bug接近Meta，底层用上Kimi和DeepSeek技术

动察 Beating AI 快讯，韩国游戏巨头 KRAFTON 发布 Raon-1 mini 预览版。这是一款从零训练的 MoE 语言模型，总参数量约 288 亿，每次推理仅激活 43 亿，重点优化韩语对话、编程和 Agent 能力，支持 26 万 Token 上下文。

虽然是从零训练，但底层技术也有中国厂商的影子。它采用混合注意力架构，25 层网络中有 18 层使用改进自 Kimi Delta Attention 的线性注意力机制。另外，团队还简化了 DeepSeek 的 mHC 超连接技术，降低训练计算开销。

KRAFTON 公布的测试显示，Raon-1 mini 在 SWE-Verified 代码修复测试中取得 70.8%，超过 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 的 63.2%，接近 Meta Muse Glimmer 的 72.0%。但在 Terminal-Bench Lite 终端操作测试中，它只有 47.0%，明显落后于 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 的 63.3% 和 Muse Glimmer 的 70.7%。指令遵循测试 IFBench 则达到 84.2%，高于上述两款模型。

模型权重已经按 Apache 2.0 协议开放，提供 GGUF、MLX 等版本，支持 Mac 本地运行。NVFP4 量化版可以部署在单张 RTX 5090 上。团队还提供 DFlash2 推测解码模型，在单张 NVIDIA B300 的测试中，相比普通解码最高提升 2.18 倍输出吞吐量。

OCC Finalizes First GENIUS Act Rule: No Safe Harbor for Existing Stablecoin Rewards

The OCC has issued its first final rule implementing the GENIUS Act, covering stablecoin issuance, custody, and third-party partnerships, effective January 18, 2027. Existing yield and rewards programs receive no automatic grandfathering or safe harbor; compliance will be assessed case by case.

The act prohibits issuers from paying yield solely for holding, using, or retaining stablecoins, but does not ban all third-party rewards. The OCC said rewards based at least partly on other factors may fall outside the prohibition. The implications for programs offered by Coinbase, PayPal, and Kraken remain uncertain. — link

items.author: Ryan Gladwin
items.content:
In brief
- Ken Kutaragi, the founder of PlayStation, said that physical discs are a "metaphor" for owning games, and calls it a "mentality issue" if you're upset about physical discs not being produced.
- It follows Sony's decision to discontinue the production of game discs as of 2028, which has received major backlash from fans.
- Game veterans told Decrypt that the disc decision is usually pushed by publishers to boost profits, and that Sony miscalculated its community's reaction.
PlayStation founder Ken Kutaragi has pushed back against fans' anger over Sony's plan to discontinue physical game discs, calling it a "mentality issue." One game industry veteran claims that cutting discs is "only" ever pushed by publishers as they seek better profit margins.
It comes amid a storm of controversy surrounding Sony's decision to stop disc production in 2028. Former PlayStation exec Shawn Layden called it a "heavily spreadsheeted decision" and said it damaged the company's reputation. Meanwhile, fans have garnered more than 385,000 signatures on a "Don't Kill the Disc" petition.
"I understand that physical discs have become a metaphor for 'owning' games. I really understand that mentality," Kutaragi said at the Game Republic New Horizons event. "But nobody thinks [physical media] is necessary for a networked device like a smartphone, for example, because people feel that they will keep their content. So it's a mentality."
Kutaragi retired from PlayStation in 2007 and is best known for being the architect of the first three generations of the PlayStation console. Since leaving, two more generations of the console have been released. He is currently serving as CEO of Japanese companies Ascent Robotics and Cyber AI Entertainment.
“I really understand [why some people are upset]," he said, according to the Video Games Chronicle. "But I don’t think it’s economically reasonable. Maybe it’s a mentality issue.”
Former creative strategist for Infinity Ward Robert Bowling told Decrypt that publishers are the "only ones ever pushing" to cut physical game discs. He said that it is because cutting discs can increase profit margins by reducing the cost of production, as well as crushing the game reseller market led by the likes of GameStop.
"It speaks to the divide that has formed in our industry between those who see games as just a software product," Bowling, who is now studio head for game studio //18.bravo, told Decrypt, "And those who see them as something more like art, entertainment, collectibles, and a lifestyle."
Sony has argued in court that no reasonable consumer believes that they own digital games they buy on the PlayStation Store, according to court filings. Instead, Sony says that Store purchases equate to purchasing a revocable license.
Game industry veteran Chris Heatherly said that corporate executives are used to "issuing decrees" from their offices and "hiding behind their PR teams," but that doesn't work in the social media age. He argues that Sony isn't "in dialogue" with its audience, so it misjudged how the move would land.
"I think it’s insult upon injury for gamers who feel used and abused by these console makers in general," Heatherly told Decrypt. "If you look at Steam, people buy way more games than they play because they like to collect games. What is that other than owning them? You’re not playing them at all!"
That said, Heatherly argues that it isn't "an entirely rational coherent thought process" to want to own online multiplayer games, since the publisher usually controls the servers anyway. But he thinks there is a middle ground.
"I think there are models for ownership worth talking about, but not fake financialized ownership like web3," he told Decrypt. "I think people would be happy with local forever and peer-to-peer [online services], frankly."

美OCC率先敲定《GENIUS法案》稳定币规则，调整第三方奖励相关条款

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 21 日，美国货币监理署（OCC）公布落实《GENIUS 法案》的最终规则，成为首个敲定该法案稳定币实施规则的监管机构。规则将于 2027 年 1 月 18 日生效，为银行及非银行企业开展支付稳定币业务提供准入路径，并确立境外稳定币发行人及资产托管的相关标准。

在稳定币奖励方面，最终规则删除了征求意见稿中针对发行人与第三方某些商业安排可能构成违法的推定条款，但发行人不得直接向稳定币持有人支付利息的法定禁令仍然适用。

监管官员表示，将逐案审查发行人与第三方的关系，确保相关安排不违反法定禁令。OCC 仍有权针对规避法案的行为执法，若发现明确的规避行为，将采取相应行动。

【美国 OCC 发布《GENIUS Act》首个最终规则，不预设现有稳定币奖励计划合规】

Foresight News 消息，据 CoinDesk 报道，美国货币监理署（OCC）10 月 21 日发布《GENIUS Act》实施最终规则，成为首个就该法案发布最终规则的联邦银行监管机构，规则将于 2027 年 1 月 18 日生效。该规则确立了受监管机构及外国公司在美国发行和托管稳定币的完整流程。针对稳定币奖励问题，OCC 表示不会预设《GENIUS Act》生效前已存在的奖励计划合规，也不会为其提供安全港，将根据每项安排的具体事实和情况逐案适用法律条文。OCC 同时指出，法案禁止的是「仅因」持有、使用或保留稳定币而支付的奖励，若奖励至少部分出于其他原因，则可能不在禁止范围内。此外，OCC 在最终规则中删除了此前提案中对特定违规活动的「可反驳推定」，并对储备资产的多元化及集中度要求改为采用基于原则的监管方式。

EAGLE-4让Qwen生成速度提升3.6倍，手机CPU也能提速3倍

动察 Beating AI 快讯，大模型推理加速公司 Eagle 发布 EAGLE-4，升级其推测解码方案。新版重点降低了草稿模型的计算开销，还能根据硬件性能和并发数量调整预测规模，避免额外的预测计算反而拖慢速度。

在 4 张 NVIDIA B300 GPU 上，Qwen3.8-27B 的单请求生成速度从每秒 240.5 Token 提高到 863.8 Token，达到普通推理的 3.6 倍。在 512 个请求同时运行时，总吞吐量从每秒 2.12 万 Token 提高到 2.83 万，提升 34%。

手机端也有明显提升。在摩托罗拉 Razr 70 Ultra 上，Gemma-4-E2B-it 仅靠 CPU 就实现了 3.2 倍的长文本生成速度，同一任务的耗时从 43 秒缩短至 14 秒，每个 Token 的能耗降低 53%。

EAGLE-4 已公开代码，支持接入 SGLang、vLLM 和实验性 TokenSpeed。但与采用 Apache 2.0 开源许可证的前三代不同，新版改用限制性商业许可证。连续 12 个月综合营收超过 2000 万美元的企业，以及提供竞争性推理服务的公司，商业使用需要另行授权。

【法国提议加密平台对其提供接入的部分 DeFi 事件承担责任】

Foresight News 消息，据 Cointelegraph 报道，法国财政部、法国金融市场管理局（AMF）、法兰西银行及法国审慎监管与处置局（ACPR）联合发布针对欧盟《加密资产市场监管法案》（MiCA）修订的提案，作为对欧盟委员会公开征询的回应。提案提出，加密资产服务提供商（CASP）在为客户提供 DeFi 协议接入前应对协议进行审查，并持续监控其漏洞及可疑活动；若平台主动为客户提供接入，应对部分影响客户的事件承担责任。法国当局还支持对 DeFi 协议及智能合约进行认证，相关要求将全面适用于重要 CASP，较小的服务商则按比例适用；平台在自行开展尽职调查并加强风险披露的前提下，仍可为客户接入未经认证的协议。非托管钱包方面，法国当局反对对开发者实施一刀切的认证要求，支持对集成 DeFi 服务的高级钱包采用自愿认证。此外，法国支持将重要 CASP 的监管权由各国监管机构移交至欧洲证券和市场管理局（ESMA），并提议下调 MiCA 目前认定重要 CASP 的欧盟日均活跃用户 1500 万门槛，同时将托管资产、业务风险及集团复杂程度纳入考量；法国还呼吁审查 MiCA 的资产参考代币（ART）类别，并建议调整电子货币代币（EMT）框架以涵盖多币种稳定币。欧盟委员会将根据征询结果，于 2027 年 6 月 30 日前向欧盟立法者提交报告，报告中或包含修订 MiCA 的提案。

items.author: Aaron Wise
items.content:
Concerning details about Anthropic’s relationship with AMD came to light after the Wall Street Journal (WSJ) reported that hyperscalers are capping Anthropic’s AI compute capacity.
Creatively, one of the ways the Claude maker has worked around these limitations is to commit to acquire billions of dollars worth of AMD’s AI computational services while AMD commits to buy billions in Anthropic stock.
Circularly, Anthropic’s IPO prospectus, seeking a generous valuation, shows AMD pledging up to $5 billion for purchases of Anthropic’s stock in the same filing as Anthropic commits to acquire AI compute services from AMD in excess of $20 billion.
Needless to say, contractors usually render services for payment, not reinvest that money back into their client’s equity. Nonetheless, AMD framed the arrangement as a “strategic partnership” aimed at locking in a marquee client.
Using different language, a skeptical person might explain the two deals as a de facto rebate via share buybacks.
For whatever reason, the unusual deal covers up to two gigawatts of AMD’s Instinct MI450 chips starting in the first half of 2027. “We are thrilled to deepen our partnership with Anthropic,” AMD’s CEO said.
That was certainly one way to describe an investment commitment of $5 billion back into its customer.
Read more: Anthropic’s non-existent blockchain shares are tripping up investors
Anthropic commits $20B as AMD commits $5B back
Conveniently, news of AMD’s original $5 billion “strategic partnership” arrived in July, months before the world read its September IPO prospectus detailing how Anthropic has committed to acquire over $20 billion worth of AMD’s AI compute capacity.
AMD’s latest quarterly report discloses “investment commitments of up to $5.0 billion, subject to certain contingencies, which are expected to be made through fiscal year 2028.”
Conspicuously absent from that filing was Anthropic, despite how obviously precise that number matches AMD’s commitment to invest into the company.
“Access to compute is central to keeping Claude at the frontier and meeting demand from our customers,” Anthropic co-founder Tom Brown said in July.
Anthropic lost money at a startling rate in 2025, running an operating loss above $8 billion on just $4.6 billion of revenue. AMD’s investment will certainly help keep Anthropic’s valuation optimistic, despite these losses.

PancakeSwap TVL tops $380M as major fee overhaul heads to vote
PancakeSwap’s proposed fee-sharing overhaul would give liquidity providers 88% of swap fees and cut CAKE emissions by 69%, as BNB Chain’s DeFi activity expands.
Decentralized exchange PancakeSwap’s total value locked (TVL) grew nearly 19% over the past week, adding about $380 million as the protocol moves toward a major overhaul of how it distributes trading fees to liquidity providers.
According to DefiLlama, PancakeSwap’s TVL climbed to $2.4 billion on Wednesday, up from about $2.02 billion on Oct. 14. The increase was concentrated in its V3 liquidity pools, where TVL more than doubled to about $739 million from $336 million over the same period.
The growth coincided with PancakeSwap opening a governance vote on a proposal called “The Flip,” which would increase liquidity providers’ share of swap fees on V3 and Infinity pools to 88%, up from 66%-68% on most pools.
The proposal would also gradually reduce daily CAKE token emissions by approximately 69%, from 22,500 to 7,000 tokens. Voting opened on Wednesday, Oct. 21, and will run until Oct. 24, with implementation expected to begin in November if approved.
PancakeSwap leads BNB Chain trading as tokenized stocks expand
PancakeSwap accounted for approximately $4.67 billion in decentralized exchange trading volume on BNB Chain over the past seven days, representing about 71% of the network’s total, according to DeFiLlama. The network also hosts most of PancakeSwap’s liquidity, accounting for roughly $2.33 billion of its $2.40 billion in TVL.
The activity comes amid broader growth across BNB Chain’s DeFi ecosystem. That network’s TVL climbed approximately 8.3% over the past seven days to $5.84 billion, according to DeFiLlama. Decentralized exchange trading volume also surged 40.2% to $6.54 billion over the same period, even as its stablecoin market capitalization declined 0.6% to $13.1 billion.
Related: Curve Finance accuses PancakeSwap of copying its code
Beyond crypto, BNB Chain has also seen an expansion in tokenized equities, a market in which PancakeSwap has an established presence. The decentralized exchange began supporting Binance’s bStocks in June, allowing users to trade tokenized US stocks onchain.
On Oct. 15, Binance announced that bStocks surpassed $1 billion in assets under management, approximately four months after launching. The company reported more than $40 billion in cumulative trading volume and said 11.2% of bStocks’ value was deployed in DeFi in early October.

Ornith-1.5新增122B：基于千问3.5架构，部分编程自测领先Qwen3.8-Flash-Next

动察 Beating AI 快讯，由知名 NLP 学者李纪为创立的 AI 团队 DeepReinforce，为 Ornith-1.5 系列新增 122B MoE 模型。

该系列早在今年 8 月就已发布，当时包括 397B、35B-A3B 和 9B 三档，这次补上了中间规格。新模型已经开放权重，同时提供 FP8、NVFP4、GGUF 和 MLX 等版本。

Ornith-1.5-122B 沿用 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 的模型架构，总参数约 122B，每次推理激活约 10B 参数。支持 256K 原生上下文、图像理解、工具调用和推理。

官方自测显示，122B 在 SWE-bench Verified（non-hack）获得 84.5 分，高于 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 的 82.8 分。CyberGym 为 80 对 78，NL2Repo 为 51.2 对 45.2，SWE-bench Pro（no-hack）则达到 76.9 对 43.9。不过，Terminal-Bench 2.1 仍以 81.2 对 83.4 落后。

值得注意的是，千问官方此前使用 Claude Code Harness，在 SWE-bench Pro 获得 62.5 分，高于 Ornith 使用 OpenHands 测出的 43.9 分，两个测试的条件并不完全一致。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz
items.content:
France proposes liability for crypto exchanges offering DeFi access
French authorities want crypto exchanges to conduct checks on DeFi protocols and face liability for certain customer losses under proposed changes to EU crypto rules.
France wants cryptocurrency platforms to face liability for certain decentralized finance (DeFi) incidents if they fail to vet protocols or ignore known security risks.
French authorities published proposals Wednesday to revise the European Union’s Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA). The joint response to a European Commission consultation came from France’s Treasury, the Financial Markets Authority (AMF), the central bank and the Prudential Supervision and Resolution Authority (ACPR).
“CASPs [crypto-asset service providers] should be liable for certain incidents affecting clients where they actively facilitated access,” French authorities said.
MiCA excludes crypto services provided in a fully decentralized manner without intermediaries. France’s proposal would extend investor safeguards by imposing new duties on regulated platforms that connect customers to DeFi protocols.
The Commission is reviewing whether MiCA needs updating as crypto markets develop. Its consultation sought views on activities outside the law’s original scope, including DeFi. The responses will inform a report to EU lawmakers due by June 30, 2027, which could include proposals to amend the law.
DeFi access could come with new obligations
French authorities proposed requiring platforms to vet DeFi protocols before offering access and monitor them for vulnerabilities and suspicious activity. They also backed certification of protocols and smart contracts, along with platform liability for certain incidents.
The requirements would apply fully to significant CASPs, with obligations scaled for smaller providers.
Platforms could still connect customers to uncertified protocols if they conduct their own due diligence and provide enhanced risk disclosures, the authorities said.
Related: Ledger’s early implant warnings deserved more action, Karpelès says
The authorities also addressed non-custodial or self-custodial wallets by opposing blanket certification requirements for developers. They favored voluntary certification for more advanced wallets that integrate DeFi services.
France pushes for wider MiCA overhaul
Beyond DeFi, France backed plans to transfer supervision of “significant CASPs” from national regulators to the European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA).
The authorities also proposed lowering MiCA’s current threshold of 15 million average daily active users in the EU for identifying significant CASPs. They also suggested considering custody assets, business risks and group complexity when deciding which platforms should fall under ESMA supervision.
Related: France advances stablecoin tax, eyes self-custodial wallets and exit tax proposals
France also called for a review of MiCA’s asset-referenced token (ART) category, which covers tokens designed to maintain a stable value by referencing assets or combinations of assets. The authorities noted that no ARTs had been authorized under MiCA and proposed adapting the e-money token (EMT) framework to cover multicurrency stablecoins.
Magazine: MiCA is coming for DeFi vaults, but regulation will be difficult

Bitcoin ‘top buyers’ halt BTC price upside with $87.7K now key: Glassnode
Bitcoin price current resistance near $87,000 was reinforced by investors who bought BTC in late 2025, per new research.
Bitcoin (BTC) investors sitting on unrealized losses are capping price gains at $87,700, while ETF inflows strengthen support at $80,000, analysis reveals.
Key points:
- Bitcoin investors who bought BTC in the latter stages of 2025 have an aggregate cost basis of around $87,700, which now functions as resistance per Glassnode analysis.
- The area immediately above $87,000 hosts several resistance levels including the 2026 open at $87,490 and the 20-month moving average at $87,165.
- Bitcoin price support at $80,000 strengthens as bid liquidity focuses on this psychological level.
Bitcoin 2025 buyers add to $87,000 resistance zone
New research from onchain analytics platform Glassnode reveals that the breakeven point for a cohort of new Bitcoin holders is currently acting as resistance.
Since the start of the year, two groups of holders have kept BTC/USD from moving higher once it challenges their acquisition cost basis.
In November 2025, price lost the cost basis of investors with entries between six and 12 months prior, which sat at $94,000 at the time. When price attempted to break above the trendline at $97,100 in January 2026, it became resistance, triggering a rejection and sending price lower.
A similar resistance trendline is given by the cost basis of investors who bought BTC one to two years prior. This cohort slipped into aggregate loss in February of this year as price lost its cost basis of $76,900. In May, the cost basis halted a price rebound at just above $82,000.
In both cases, underwater buyers looking to exit their positions at breakeven produced a wall of sell-side pressure that new demand could not match. Commenting, Glassnode noted the extent of BTC price retracements after rejections from either cost basis.
“Bitcoin rose to the 6-12 month cost basis in January and then fell by more than a third. It met the 1-2 year cost basis in May and fell by about a quarter,” it said. “The 1-2 year holders also stepped up their selling into the rally at the start of October.”
The cost bases for the six-to-12-month cohort and one-to-two-year cohort are currently $87,700 and $99,500, respectively.
BTC/USD chart with cohort breakeven levels (screenshot). Source: Glassnode
The area above $87,000 also contains the 2026 opening price at $87,490 and the 20-month simple moving average (SMA) for BTC/USD at $87,165, a level that has historically preceded new all-time highs once reclaimed as support.
ETF cost basis hosts new BTC price support
Below current spot price, the cost basis of the US spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs) marks one of several support levels of interest around the $80,000 mark.
Related: XRP 30-day exchange inflows pass 6B tokens as whales move to the sidelines
Glassnode calculates the spot ETF cost basis at $81,500, while Bitcoin’s true market mean — the cost basis for all BTC acquired on secondary markets — sits at $77,500. Below this, the breakeven point of Bitcoin’s short-term holders — wallet entities holding a given amount of BTC for up to six months without selling — lies at $74,600.
As an important psychological level, $80,000 now forms a magnet for bid liquidity across exchange order books.
“The block sits just under the US Spot ETF Cost Basis, so the zone between $80K and $81.5K is where order-book and on-chain support overlap. A break below it would bring the liquidation cluster just under $80K, and then the True Market Mean near $78K, into play,” Glassnode commented.
BTC/USD chart with cost-basis data, true market mean (screenshot). Source: Glassnode

items.author: Decrypt Agent
items.content:
In brief
- Advocacy group Stand With Crypto said UK bank customers filed 10,092 complaints over blocked or restricted transfers to crypto exchanges in 90 days.
- Lloyds Banking Group received 2,297 complaints, followed by Barclays with 1,569 and NatWest Group with 1,278, according to the report.
- The group urged the FCA and Treasury to make clear that sector-wide blocks are not proportionate, ahead of the UK's crypto regime taking effect next year.
UK bank customers sent 10,092 complaints about blocked or restricted transfers to crypto exchanges over 90 days, crypto advocacy group Stand With Crypto said in a report published on Tuesday.
The complaints were filed by 9,803 people between May and August 2026 through an online tool run by the group, and concerned transfers to platforms registered with the Financial Conduct Authority, the UK's financial regulator. They came from every one of the UK's 650 parliamentary constituencies, the group said in a tweet.
📣 We are pleased to announce our report, Blocked: Britain’s Crypto Access Problem, is live.
In just 90 days, people sent 10,092 complaints to their banks about fiat transfers to crypto exchanges being blocked or restricted. Complaints came from every single one of the UK’s 650… pic.twitter.com/jWXbhbJTyZ
— Stand With Crypto In The UK🛡️🇬🇧 (@StandWCrypto_UK) October 20, 2026
Lloyds Banking Group, which includes Halifax and Bank of Scotland, received the most, with 2,297, or more than 22% of the total, even though it has no published policy restricting crypto transfers. Barclays received 1,569 and NatWest Group, which includes Royal Bank of Scotland, 1,278. HSBC UK also received more than 1,000, according to the report, which does not give its exact total. Virgin Money and the Co-operative Bank received the fewest, with 103 and 76 respectively. Decrypt has reached out to Lloyds Banking Group and HSBC UK for comment.
Six banks publish limits on crypto transfers, according to the report. Barclays caps them at £2,500 per transaction and £10,000 every 30 days, NatWest at £1,000 a day and £5,000 every 30 days, and Santander UK at £1,000 per transaction and £3,000 every 30 days. Starling, TSB, Chase UK, Metro Bank, Virgin Money and the Co-operative Bank block crypto transfers entirely.
"The protection of our customers' funds is our highest priority," a Barclays spokesperson told Decrypt. "Like many other banks, we've introduced limits on payments to cryptocurrency exchanges to help protect customers from crypto-related scams and losses."
A spokesperson for NatWest referred to a statement on the bank's website, which highlights a "growing risk from fraudsters," exploiting the popularity of cryptocurrency. "To help protect our customers and keep their money safe and secure, we took the decision to block or limit online banking, debit card transactions and mobile app Faster Payments identified as going to cryptocurrency exchanges from 16th March 2023," the bank said.
Banks that apply limits received 6,198 complaints, while those with no published policy, Lloyds and Revolut, received 2,842. Banks with outright bans received 989, which the report suggests may be because their customers know not to try.
"A customer cannot reliably use their bank's published policy to predict whether they will be able to transfer their own money to a crypto asset platform," the report said.
The figures are not weighted by each bank's market share, since the number of current accounts each offers is not public, and customers could complain to more than one bank.
The UK's crypto regime
The report cites a 2025 FCA and YouGov survey in which 13% of UK crypto users said they had faced problems withdrawing crypto to their bank account, the most common negative experience reported. Its findings also echo a January survey by the UK Cryptoasset Business Council, which estimated that banks were blocking or delaying around 40% of transfers to the country's 10 largest exchanges, with one exchange seeing close to £1 billion in declined transactions over a year.
Some restrictions date back years. TSB has banned crypto purchases since 2021, and Barclays blocked crypto purchases made with its credit cards from June 2025. Reform UK leader Nigel Farage has pledged to outlaw banks from denying services to customers over their involvement with crypto if he becomes prime minister.
Lawmakers have also taken up the issue, though their focus has largely been on crypto businesses rather than individual customers. Parliament's Crypto and Digital Assets All-Party Parliamentary Group launched an inquiry in July into crypto firms' access to bank accounts and services, which also covers the transfer limits and payment blocks banks impose. In August, its co-chairs, Labour MP Gurinder Singh Josan and Lord Vaizey of Didcot, wrote to the chief executives of every major UK bank asking how they treat crypto firms and what limits they apply to crypto-related transactions. Access to banking services "could be one of the single biggest barriers to growth" for UK crypto businesses, they warned.
Stand With Crypto called on banks to replace blanket restrictions with risk-based, case-by-case checks, to publish plain-language policies on when crypto transfers may be blocked, and to give customers a way to challenge or opt out of controls on transfers to FCA-registered providers.
It also urged the FCA and HM Treasury to state publicly that sector-wide blocks and hard caps on transfers to registered or authorized crypto firms are unlikely to be justified by anti-fraud or financial crime rules. The FCA's crypto regime comes into force next year, and firms that have secured authorization "should have assurance" they will not face blanket barriers from other regulated firms, the report said.

items.content:
3.2万星DeepSeek插件dsh-our-free-model遭神秘「律师函」威胁：要求7天删库，落款却是空白

动察 Beating AI 快讯，GitHub 上拥有约 3.2 万 Star 的 DeepSeek 开源插件项目 dsh-our-free-model 突然收到一份长达 2 万字符的「律师函」。

发帖者自称受 WorkBuddy、CodeBuddy 权利方委托，指控项目逆向腾讯官方客户端、绕过接口校验，并利用免费积分调用 AI 模型。函件要求开发者在 3 天内停止相关行为，7 天内删除整个仓库，否则将面临诉讼和监管举报。

但项目早在当天上午 10:29 就已移除腾讯两个渠道。下午 16:21，另一名贡献者提交 PR，尝试通过改写请求内容绕过腾讯的客户端校验，恢复模型调用。约 39 分钟后，「律师函」出现。该贡献者随后主动撤回 PR，相关代码并未合并。

有点离谱的是，这份函件连律师事务所、承办律师、授权权利人和联系方式都没有填写，也没有签章。发帖账号直到 10 月 16 日才注册。函件还声称，开发者移除腾讯渠道仅 3 分钟后就提交代码试图恢复。但 GitHub 公开记录显示，相关 PR 实际相隔近 6 小时。

目前尚无腾讯官方确认发函的消息。社区大量开发者质疑其真实性，怀疑是有人借律师函名义施压。

items.content:
Shinhan, SBI make Japan-Korea tourist spending a test case for yen stablecoins
The companies will assess safeguards for travelers and whether stablecoins can speed up trade settlement between South Korea and Japan.
South Korea’s Shinhan Card announced Wednesday that it signed an agreement with Japan’s SBI VC Trade and SBI XDC Network APAC to test yen stablecoin payments for travelers and cross-border trade settlement.
Under the pact signed Tuesday, the companies will test stablecoin card payments, wallet-to-wallet payments and cross-border trade settlement. They will also assess anti-money-laundering and fraud-detection controls.
Shinhan Card is one of South Korea’s biggest credit card companies. SBI is a Japanese financial heavyweight that runs banks, brokerages, insurers and crypto exchanges.
The latest initiative is intended to support cross-border payments and settlement between the East Asian nations and improve payment convenience for travelers.
Travel between the two countries generated more than 10 million visitor arrivals in the first eight months of 2026, according to official tourism figures from both countries. South Korea was Japan’s largest source of foreign visitors with 7.42 million arrivals. Japan was its neighbor’s second-largest source with 2.7 million arrivals.
Shinhan Card announced in April that it had completed a proof-of-concept testing that covered stablecoin payments and cross-border settlement.
SBI VC Trade registered in March 2025 as Japan’s first electronic payment instruments exchange service provider, enabling it to handle USDC.
Related: Binance Pay lets visitors spend crypto at PayPay merchants in Japan

items.content:
Zcash rallies 12% as developers finalize NU7 activation height
Zcash extended triple-digit year-to-date gains as developers agreed on the NU7 mainnet activation height, targeting Nov. 5, with node synchronization work still pending.
Zcash (ZEC) surged about 12% over the past 24 hours, as developers agreed on a mainnet activation block for the network’s NU7 upgrade, expected in early November.
The token traded around $1,270 at last look on Wednesday, according to CoinGecko. The rally coincided with a Tuesday GitHub proposal by Zcash developer Sean Bowe setting the activation at block 3,543,405, expected around Nov. 5.
The value of the privacy-focused cryptocurrency that uses advanced trustless zero-knowledge proofs is up more than 148% year to date.
“Height agreed at ZIP editor meeting,” Bowe wrote, adding that the team still needed to finalize the upgrade specifications before merging the proposal. Two developers approved the changes.
The Zakura NU7 dashboard also lists the upgrade as pending on mainnet at block 3,543,405, with activation expected around Nov. 5.
NU7 aims to reduce Zcash’s target block time by two-thirds to 25 seconds, allowing transactions to receive confirmations more quickly. The upgrade from 75-second block time has been undergoing testing since early October.
Meanwhile, the Zcash Foundation’s NU7 readiness tracker showed six of 12 tasks completed, with remaining work involving Zebra node synchronization issues and mainnet preparations. Developers have not confirmed whether these outstanding issues could affect the planned activation date.

items.author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai
items.content:
Drift exploiter sends $109M in Ether to Tornado Cash in 2 days
Wallets linked to the $295 million April hack still held $138 million in Ether after sending another $46 million to the mixer Wednesday.
A Drift exploiter-linked wallet transferred 18,800 Ether, worth about $46 million, to Tornado Cash on Wednesday.
The exploiter transferred $61 million in Ether to the crypto mixer on Tuesday, taking its two-day total to 44,510 ETH, or $109 million, as blockchain data tracker Onchain Lens said on X.
The transfers to Tornado Cash make the funds harder to trace and represent nearly 37% of the $295 million stolen from decentralized exchange (DEX) Drift in April. The attack ranks as this year’s third-largest crypto hack, according to DefiLlama.
The Drift exploiter-labelled wallets still held 56,569 Ether, worth roughly $138 million after Wednesday’s flurry of transfers, Arkham data shows.
The Solana-based DEX reported about $295 million in losses from the April 1 hack, which its security consultant Mandiant attributed to a North Korean threat group.
Drift opened claims and redemptions for DFX recovery tokens on Oct. 1, giving affected users a claim on a pool that launched with about $3.1 million and receives exchange revenue and recovered funds.
Related: HEX token sellers erase $160M following reports of Richard Heart’s arrest

items.content:
Delphi长文研报：投资者寻求高回报成时代特征，持有关键交易平台标的为核心思路

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 21 日，加密研究机构 Delphi Digital 在报告《The House Always Wins: Why Speculation Is the Theme of the Decade》中认为，技术变革与家庭经济压力正共同推动投机需求。报告称，人工智能等新技术扩大了市场对未来产业的分歧，而住房可负担性、就业前景等因素也可能促使部分投资者寻求高回报交易。

基于这一判断，报告提出「持有交易场平台」的思路，关注承接交易并通过手续费或用户分发获利的平台。报告提及 Robinhood、Cboe、CME、Coinbase、Interactive Brokers 和 DraftKings 等传统平台，以及 Hyperliquid（HYPE）、Lighter（LIT）、Derive 和 Paradex 等链上交易或期权平台；Kalshi、Polymarket 等尚未上市的预测市场则被列为观察对象。

Delphi Digital 表示，Robinhood 将期权、加密资产和事件合约纳入同一平台，有机会从不同交易热点中获益。其他平台则各有切入点：Cboe 拥有标普 500 指数当日期权业务，CME 为 FanDuel Predicts 提供合约，DraftKings 已将预测产品迁至自有交易所；Coinbase 通过 Kalshi 接入预测市场，并拥有加密期权交易所 Deribit；Interactive Brokers 则运营 ForecastEx。

在链上平台中，报告将 Hyperliquid 视为较成熟的案例。该平台 2025 年交易手续费约为 9.72 亿美元，交易量约 3 万亿美元，协议收入主要用于回购 HYPE。其 HIP-3 功能还允许部署者上线原油、贵金属和股票等永续合约，扩展交易标的与时段。

报告认为，Lighter 是值得关注的第二家链上平台，其订单簿撮合使用零知识证明，面向普通用户的交易暂不收费，并支持股票、大宗商品和外汇等标的；Robinhood Wallet 也已接入其永续合约服务。但免费交易模式下，Lighter 未来的收入来源及 LIT 代币价值捕获仍待验证。Derive 和 Paradex 则被归为链上期权领域的早期项目。

items.content:
Meta Muse曝隐私漏洞：一搜找到6800多个聊天链接，企业机密也被翻出

动察 Beating AI 快讯，美国网络安全公司 Claroc 发现，Meta 个人 AI Agent Muse 的聊天分享链接可以被陌生人批量检索。研究人员只查询了一次 DNS 历史数据库，就找到超过 6800 个分享链接。抽查数百条后，发现数十份敏感资料，包括企业内部营收报告、小企业贷款申请，以及一名候选人与前沿 AI 实验室秘密招聘沟通的准备材料，连内部联系人和会议时间都暴露了。

用户让 Muse 分享聊天时，系统会生成一个无需登录即可查看的网页，并把聊天标题和随机 ID 一起写进域名。有人打开页面后，完整域名就可能被第三方 DNS 服务记录。Claroc 直接搜索这些历史记录，就拿到了原本难以猜测的分享地址。Muse 虽然要求搜索引擎不要抓取这些页面，却挡不住域名被其他服务记录。

Claroc 早在 10 月 8 日就向 Meta 报告漏洞，10 月 18 日公开研究。直到 10 月 20 日，美国科技媒体 Ars Technica 介入询问后，Meta 才确认暂停聊天分享功能。Claroc 当天复查了此前无需登录就能打开的 40 个链接，发现均已失效，但聊天标题仍留在 DNS 历史记录中。

Meta CEO 扎克伯格上个月还宣称，Muse 是一款「从底层为隐私和安全而设计」的产品。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372971

items.content:
Gradium开源超小语音模型：权重仅64MB，手机断网也能开口说话

动察 Beating AI 快讯，AI 语音公司 Gradium 开源语音生成模型 Phonon。它在今年 4 月以约 1 亿参数开始私测，这次推出 3100 万和 4000 万参数版本，并首次公开模型权重。其中，3100 万参数英语版的 Q8 权重仅 64MB，普通 CPU 就能运行。4000 万参数版支持英、法、德、西、葡五种语言，提供单语言及五语合一模型。

Phonon 通过蒸馏更大的模型训练而来。它直接读取文本，不必先转换成音素，再利用 Transformer 逐步预测声音特征，通过 Mimi 解码器生成音频。每次输出对应 80 毫秒的语音，可以边合成边播放，不必等整句话生成完。

速度方面，Gradium 披露，Phonon 在骁龙 8 Elite Gen 5 上生成首段音频仅需 7.5 毫秒，合成速度达到实时的 24 倍。在 MacBook Air M5 的 CPU 上，首音约 7 毫秒。

音质方面，Gradium 组织了 1189 名试听者，完成超过 1.7 万次盲听投票。3100 万参数英语版获得 2098 Elo，高于 1 亿参数 Pocket TTS 的 2056。在另一项包含电话号码、邮箱等复杂文本的 500 句英语测试中，Phonon 的词错误率为 1.7%，低于另一款 8200 万参数开源语音模型 Kokoro 的 3.5%。这些成绩均来自 Gradium 公布的测试。

Phonon 已接入 Ollama、MLX-Audio 等工具。合作方 Xybrid 还在一台 16GB M1 Pro MacBook 上，同时运行 8B Agent、Whisper 和 Phonon，让 3D 游戏角色在完全断网的情况下实时对话。

目前只有 3100 万参数英语版采用 Apache 2.0 许可证，允许商业使用。4000 万参数及多语言版本采用 CC BY-NC 许可证，商用需另行授权。暂未发布中文模型。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372962

Zcash Plans NU7 Activation Around November 5, Cutting Block Times to 25 Seconds

Zcash developers have agreed on block 3,543,405 for NU7 activation, expected around November 5. The upgrade will reduce block times from 75 seconds to 25 seconds. It will also temporarily remove 60% of each block’s transaction fees from circulation, with payments to miners beginning around February 2031, while preserving the existing mining reward halving schedule.

Zcash’s original privacy system, Sprout, will shut down entirely, making any funds not moved before activation unspendable. As of October 21 at 08:00 (UTC), the activation-height proposal had not yet been merged into the deployment specification. The chosen height must also be incorporated into node software before the upgrade can take effect. — link

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 21 日，Zcash 开发者已就 NU7 升级达成一致，计划在区块高度 3,543,405（预计约为 11 月 5 日）激活该升级。此次升级将出块时间从 75 秒缩短至 25 秒，使交易确认速度提升至原先的三倍；同时，每个区块所收取费用的 60% 将退出流通，并计划自 2031 年 2 月起向矿工返还，期间仍维持原有的区块奖励减半计划。

消息人士：日本央行将在下周会议上决定通胀率是否已达到2%的目标

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 21 日，据日本共同社，知情人士周三透露，日本央行将在下周的政策会议上，评估潜在通胀率是否已达到 2% 的目标。若做出这一认定，将成为日本央行的一个象征性转折点，标志着该行将告别长期以来旨在对抗通缩的货币政策导向。

日本央行于 2013 年 1 月首次设定了 2% 的通胀目标。尽管实施了激进的货币宽松计划，但该行却多次推迟了实现这一目标的预期时间。若最终达成目标，距离该目标首次提出已过去近 14 年。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372956

【ZeroDev 创始人：EIP-8288 拟利用内存池并行聚合证明，提升以太坊扩展能力】

Foresight News 消息，ZeroDev 创始人 Derek Chiang 分享以太坊改进提案 EIP-8288（又名「递归内存池聚合」）的可视化解读。其表示，该方案将以太坊的去中心化交易内存池用作并行零知识证明集群：客户端提交签名和证明后，由内存池节点经过多轮递归聚合，逐步减少证明数量，最终由区块构建者聚合为单个区块级证明。Chiang 称，这一设计可通过增加节点提升签名及证明处理能力，同时保持单个节点的证明传输带宽需求稳定，且无需随处理量增长而提高区块构建者的硬件要求。验证者仅需检查一个聚合证明，即可验证数千个签名和证明。此外，该方案可将不同签名方案封装为 STARK 证明，以支持包括后量子签名在内的多种密码学方案。Chiang 认为，该设计有望支持每秒数万笔后量子及隐私交易，并降低单笔交易的验证 Gas 开销。EIP-8288 目前仍处于草案阶段，上述性能为其对方案潜力的描述。此前，Vitalik Buterin 于 10 月 19 日表示，其认为支持各类密码学方案的理想路径是 EIP-8288。
https://foresightnews.pro/news/h5Detail/115648
items.title: 【ZeroDev 创始人：EIP-8288 拟利用内存池并行聚合证明，提升以太坊扩展能力】

items.content:
估值45亿美元的humans&推出协作模型：先造「虚拟人」，再教AI组队干活

动察 Beating AI 快讯，今年 1 月，成立仅约 3 个月的 AI 公司 humans& 就拿到 4.8 亿美元种子轮融资，估值达到 44.8 亿美元。创始团队包括参与 Claude、Grok 研发的研究员，以及谷歌第 7 位员工 Georges Harik。融资时公司尚未推出产品，团队曾透露，未来可能开发类似 Slack、Notion 的多人协作工具。

9 月，humans& 先发布用户模拟模型 Persimmon；10 月 20 日，又推出基于智谱 GLM 5.3 训练的协作模型 Ampersand。

Persimmon 专门模拟真实人类的行为。它扮演的用户会拒绝建议、临时改变主意，也会反对 AI 过度干涉。Ampersand 则与这些「虚拟人」持续互动，在跨度最长达数月的模拟环境中学习协调任务、处理分歧。团队通过强化学习，让模型根据长期互动的结果不断调整行为。评测会计算它帮助每个人推进目标的收益，同时扣除违背用户偏好带来的成本。

在 CooperBench 协同编程测试中，两个 Agent 需要在同一个代码库里开发可能互相冲突的功能。原版 GLM 5.3 单独完成任务的成功率为 52.5%，与另一名 Agent 协作时却跌至 17.3%。经过训练，Ampersand 的协作成功率提高到 39%，达到原版的 2.25 倍，单独完成任务的成功率则略降至 48.8%。

Ampersand 目前通过 API 开放，humans& 还在开发自己的多人协作产品。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372954
items.title: 估值45亿美元的humans&推出协作模型：先造「虚拟人」，再教AI组队干活

【Bittensor 推出 eTAO，子网所有者可自定义排放分配比例】

Foresight News 消息，Bittensor 开发团队 Opentensor 基金会发推宣布推出 eTAO，子网所有者可自行调整子网 alpha 排放在所有者、验证者和矿工之间的分配比例。此前所有子网统一采用所有者 18%、验证者及其质押者 41%、矿工 41% 的标准分配。eTAO 的协议限制为：所有者 0 至 33%（租赁创建的子网至少 18%）；验证者最高 50%，并设有可变最低比例以保护根网络；矿工至少 33%；所有者约每 7 天可更新一次分配。例如，所有者可保留 18%，分配 20% 给验证者，并将矿工份额提高至 62%。为保障根网络 TAO 质押者收益，所有者调整分配时，eTAO 会自动调整子网的有效 TAO 权重，使根网络质押者所得份额与默认分配下保持一致。验证者比例由 41% 降至 20% 时，有效 TAO 权重可由 18% 升至 43.9%，根网络仍可获得约 5.4% 的子网排放。eTAO 不改变子网获得的 alpha 总量，现有子网在所有者主动调整前将维持当前分配。
https://foresightnews.pro/news/h5Detail/115646
items.title: 【Bittensor 推出 eTAO，子网所有者可自定义排放分配比例】

贝莱德CEO：AI数据中心若建设放缓，将推高算力成本，加剧通胀压力

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 21 日，全球最大资产管理公司贝莱德首席执行官拉里·芬克（Larry Fink）本周三警告，人工智能数据中心建设如果放缓，可能进一步推高算力成本，加剧通胀压力，并威胁经济增长。

芬克认为，加快数据中心建设能够增加市场算力供应，从而更快降低计算成本。他进一步警告，如果放慢相关技术基础设施的扩张速度，经济增长前景可能受到威胁。

这一表态正值全球 AI 投资面临融资成本上升、电力供应紧张及地方社区反对等多重挑战之际。部分数据中心项目已经出现延期，投资者对大型科技企业持续扩张资本开支的能力也更加谨慎。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372952

items.author: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz
items.content:
Ether ETF outflows continue, pass $1B in October so far
US spot Ether ETFs have shed $1.08 billion so far in October, the biggest monthly outflow of 2026, while Bitcoin ETF inflows slowed after Monday’s spike.
The cash drain from US spot Ether exchange-traded funds (ETFs) rolled on as the funds surpassed $1 billion in withdrawals so far in October.
Ether ETFs net outflows totalled $1.08 billion since the start of October after adding $26 million on Tuesday, according to SoSoValue data. The month’s withdrawals erased September’s $832 million in net inflows, leaving year-to-date net inflows at approximately $485 million.
October has already recorded the largest monthly net outflow since November 2025, with eight trading sessions still to go.
The outflows coincided with Ether’s 9.7% slide in October, from $2,700 to $2,438 at publication. ETH was down nearly 18% throughout 2026, according to CoinGecko.
Meanwhile, Bitcoin ETFs recorded $23 million in net inflows on Tuesday, adding to $527 million on Monday.
US spot Bitcoin ETFs have recorded about $67 million in net outflows in October, leaving net inflows for the year at roughly $809 million, according to SoSoValue.
Bitcoin traded at $82,954 at the time of publication, down 2.2% since Oct. 1 and 5.3% year-to-date.
Related: BlackRock files for third Bitcoin ETF, still no Solana or XRP
items.title: Ether ETF outflows continue, pass $1B in October so far

安全机构：Drift黑客再向Tornado Cash转入4600枚ETH，约合1123万美元

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 21 日，据安全机构 Salus 监测，10 月 21 日，Drift Protocol 攻击者开始转移另一长期休眠钱包中的资金，向 Tornado Cash 存入 4600 枚 ETH，价值约 1123 万美元。目前，其追踪的两个关联钱包已累计向 Tornado Cash 存入 30310 枚 ETH。

其中，0xaa8 开头地址在此前向 Tornado Cash 存入 19600 枚 ETH 后，又存入 6110 枚 ETH，累计达 25710 枚 ETH。另一 0xd3f 开头地址在沉寂约 202 天后首次转出资金，并在约 19 分钟内分 46 笔向 Tornado Cash 存入 4600 枚 ETH。该地址此前通过 11 个钱包累计接收约 24882 枚 ETH，资金主要来源于通过 CCTP 从 Solana 跨链并兑换为 ETH 的 USDC，截至本次监测时仍持有约 20286 枚 ETH。

Bria用授权数据训练出8B图像模型：追平千问，开源但不能直接商用

动察 Beating AI 快讯，AI 图像公司 Bria 发布 Fibo 2.0，参数量为 80 亿，首次将文生图和图片编辑两种能力整合进同一个模型。

用户可以通过自然语言修改照片，也能用结构化 JSON 指定人物位置、光线和文字，尽量避免修改一处却破坏其他部分。它还支持蒙版编辑和多图参考。

Bria 同时开放了完整的 Dev 版本，以及只需 4 步推理、专门加速修图的 Edit Turbo。

在 Artificial Analysis 的 AA-Image-Editing v2.1 榜单中，Fibo 2.0 以 1087 Elo 排名开源模型第一，略高于 Qwen-Image-2.1 的 1083。文生图榜单则是 Qwen 以 1042 分领先 Fibo 的 1039 分。两项差距均未达到统计显著水平，基本处于同一梯队。

Fibo 2.0 完全使用获得授权的图片训练。Bria 此前就与 Getty Images 等版权方合作，通过付费获取训练素材。但模型权重采用 CC BY-NC 4.0 非商业许可，开发者可以下载研究和微调，商业使用则需要与 Bria 另行签约。

智谱新模型被曝最高3.5万亿参数，有望达到Claude Fable级别

动察 Beating AI 快讯，一份在投资社区流传的专家访谈纪要称，智谱下一代基座模型并非此前传闻的 1.6 万亿参数，而是达到 2.5 万亿至 3.5 万亿参数。

智谱今年 8 月发布的 GLM-5.3 仍沿用上一代基座，总参数约 7440 亿。如果消息属实，新基座规模将扩大至现款的约 3.4 至 4.7 倍。

不过，训练过程并不顺利。纪要称，智谱这次采用了更激进的模型架构，预训练期间一度出现 Loss 不降，也就是持续投入算力，训练指标却无法继续改善。

受访者认为问题最近应该已经解决，预计很快完成训练，并预测新模型能够达到 Claude Fable 级别的旗舰水平。

新模型还想解决大模型发布后「发得出、供不上」的问题。纪要称，智谱从架构设计阶段就将推理速度和成本作为硬约束，目标是发布首日便能大规模提供服务，同时已有多家云厂商洽谈收入分成。

items.content:
印度CA机构eMudhra曝私钥生成漏洞，全球浏览器紧急拉黑防范中间人攻击

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 21 日，一起引发全球网络安全界高度关注的证书颁发机构（CA）安全事件被曝光。印度 CA 机构 eMudhra 被安全研究人员发现，其签发的 8 个中间证书私钥存在极其严重的生成缺陷。这些本应具有极高安全强度的私钥，由于实现错误，其实际有效信息仅相当于极小的整数（如 4、56、66 等），导致安全人员能在不到一秒的时间内将其完全破解。这一漏洞使得原本用于保障网络通信安全的信任基石形同虚设。

中间证书是 HTTPS 加密信任链中的关键环节，其私钥一旦被轻易获取，攻击者便可利用其伪造受信任的 HTTPS 证书，进而针对银行、邮箱或任何受信任的网站发起中间人攻击，拦截、篡改或窃取用户的通信数据。事件的根源并非外部黑客的恶意入侵，而是 eMudhra 在证书生成环节出现了灾难性的实现错误，生产出了安全性近乎于零的私钥。

事件曝光后，全球主要浏览器与软件厂商迅速采取了紧急防御措施。Chrome、Firefox、Apple 以及 Microsoft 均已发布安全更新，将这 8 个存在风险的中间证书列入黑名单，阻止用户访问由它们签发的虚假证书。与此同时，eMudhra 公司自身也已正式吊销了这些存在缺陷的证书。此外，由于大量软件依赖自带的证书信任库，Go、Python、Rust 以及 Electron 等主流开发语言和框架也已紧急推送更新，在各自的生态内封禁了这些受影响的证书。

截至目前，全球安全机构尚未发现这些脆弱的私钥被恶意利用以签发伪造证书的证据。然而，考虑到庞大的物联网设备以及未及时更新的旧版系统，全面清理这一安全隐患仍需时间。安全专家提醒用户称，当前最直接有效的防护措施是确保浏览器和操作系统处于最新版本，以便及时获取最新的证书黑名单，保障自身的网络访问安全。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372933

ZachXBT: Institution Suspected of Losing $2.84M to North Korean Group SquidSquad

On-chain investigator ZachXBT reported that an unnamed institution was suspected of being compromised on BNB Chain on October 8, losing roughly $2.84 million to North Korea-linked entity SquidSquad. According to his tracking, the attacker deposited 1,111.2 ETH into Tornado Cash on October 20, withdrew the funds across three addresses, and bridged the proceeds from Ethereum to Tron via USDT0. The funds were then aggregated into two addresses that show transaction linkages to wallets previously attributed to North Korea. Within minutes, the stolen assets were routed through intermediary addresses to Chinese OTC brokers, a tactic ZachXBT believes was intended to evade potential asset freezes by Tether. — link

items.content:
Anthropic CEO罕见长文辩护：AI快到必须减速，公司却仍要站在最前沿

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Anthropic 最近向美国国会议员提交了一份 AI 安全法案草案，遭到了美国 AI 安全派的质疑。

草案对政府紧急叫停危险模型设置了很高的门槛：风险须涉及生物武器、网络攻击或 AI 失控等情形，并可能造成超过 50 人死亡或重伤，或超过 10 亿美元损失。部分条款还可能限制州政府的监管权限。

AI 安全组织 Encode AI 的战略负责人 Nathan Calvin 随后翻出 Anthropic 过去一年的一系列决定。今年 2 月，Anthropic 修改了原本严格的安全政策。过去，公司承诺如果安全措施跟不上模型能力，就暂停训练或发布；新政策则不再要求公司在更高风险阶段独自停止研发，理由是竞争对手可能趁机超车。

与此同时，公司投入巨额算力、组建芯片团队，让 Claude 承担越来越多的 AI 研发任务。Nathan 质疑，Anthropic 一边强调 AI 安全，一边放松对自身的约束，甚至在立法草案中提出可能削弱政府监管的条款。这些决定究竟是偶然失误，还是公司为了保持竞争优势作出的选择？

10 月 21 日，Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 罕见地亲自在 X 上发表长文反驳。他承认公司犯过一些错误，却坚持认为，争夺最先进的 AI 能力从来没有违背 Anthropic 的安全使命。公司一直奉行「向上竞赛」策略：只有自己保持在技术最前沿，才有能力推动整个行业提高安全标准。他还列举了九项曾让公司付出商业代价的安全决定，包括将 Mythos 级模型限制开放数月，以及严格限制生物学相关请求，宁愿误拦正常科研、损失客户，也要防止技术被滥用。

Dario 同时承认，AI 正接近能够加速下一代 AI 研发、让安全措施难以跟上的阶段。Anthropic 在 10 月 19 日更新的安全路线图中也明确写道，现有政策主要针对危险模型的部署，未来可能需要直接限制研发速度，因为速度本身也可能成为风险。公司计划在 2027 年 1 月 15 日前提出相关政策方案，或者解释为什么没有提出。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372930

items.content:
「互联网地基」PHP爆出高危漏洞，全球海量网站面临被完全接管危机

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 21 日，据 huntress 报道，一场可能波及全球海量网站的安全危机正在酝酿。用于构建互联网的流行编程语言 PHP 被曝出存在两个极其严重的安全漏洞。由于相关信息被提前泄露，PHP 官方已被迫宣布将紧急发布安全补丁的时间提前至 10 月 21 日。

据悉，PHP 是 WordPress、Drupal 等众多建站系统、企业官网以及各类网络控制面板的底层基石。正因为它无处不在，一旦其核心出现问题，就相当于整个互联网的基础设施裂开了一道缝隙。

这两个漏洞被官方评为最高危级别，属于「远程代码执行」漏洞，代号为「php2shell」。简单来说，这就好比黑客找到了一把能直接打开服务器大门的万能钥匙。攻击者只需向受影响的网站发送一个特制的网络请求，就能在服务器上执行任意命令，完全接管系统。更棘手的是，目前关于该漏洞的技术细节尚未完全公开，这意味着在补丁发布前，防守方正处于极为被动的状态。由于 10 月 20 日有人在论坛上提前泄露了这一消息，为了防止黑客抢先利用，官方不得不将原定计划提前到了美东时间 10 月 21 日上午 10 点。

虽然补丁即将发布，但在毫无技术细节的情况下，全球的安全团队都在通过监控服务器的「反常行为」来排查潜在的入侵。网络安全公司 Huntress 指出，当黑客利用该漏洞攻击成功后，往往会露出马脚。比如，原本只负责处理网页请求的 PHP 程序，可能会突然反常地去启动命令行终端（如 bash）、运行 Python 等解释器，或者调用 curl 等工具去下载恶意文件。如果网站服务器上突然出现这类异常的联动操作，通常意味着黑客已经在后台悄悄活动了。

Huntress 表示，对于各类企业和网站管理员而言，留给他们的时间已经非常紧迫。在补丁发布之前，最紧要的任务是全面盘点公司内部所有运行 PHP 的地方，不仅包括对外的网页服务器，还要排查隐藏在产品设备或控制面板中的 PHP 环境。一旦补丁发布，必须第一时间优先为公网暴露的系统打上补丁。此外，如果企业仍在使用早已停止维护的旧版 PHP，将很可能等不到官方修复，必须立刻采取断网或升级等隔离措施。同时，对于普通网民来说，如果在近期访问某些网站时遇到短暂的紧急维护或无法访问，这很可能是各大平台在争分夺秒地修补这扇「大门」，以抵御这场随时可能爆发的网络风暴。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372928
items.title: 「互联网地基」PHP爆出高危漏洞，全球海量网站面临被完全接管危机

items.author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra
items.content:
Malaysia central bank launches DLT platform for tokenized bonds
The platform tracks tokenized securities ownership and transfers, linking to Malaysia’s RENTAS+ system to settle corresponding payments in central bank money.
Malaysia’s central bank has launched a distributed ledger-based platform for issuing and holding tokenized bonds, connecting digital securities records with a payment system designed to operate around the clock.
Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM) said that its next-generation Scripless Securities Depository System (SSDS+) supports the issuance, depository and safekeeping of tokenized debt securities, including Islamic bonds known as sukuk.
The new platform tracks ownership and transfers of tokenized securities and connects to the Real Time Electronic Transfer of Funds and Securities (RENTAS+) system, which handles corresponding bond payments in central bank money.
Although designed for wholesale issuance, the central bank said SSDS+ is also ready to support tokenized government bonds and corporate retail bonds. The announcement did not identify any securities already issued through the platform or disclose transaction volumes.
The rollout follows BNM’s three-year asset tokenization roadmap unveiled in November 2025, which outlined plans for pilot projects involving Islamic finance, supply chain financing and programmable payments.
In February, the central bank tested ringgit stablecoins and tokenized bank deposits through its Digital Asset Innovation Hub, with participation from major banks like Standard Chartered, CIMB Group Holding, Maybank and investment holding company Capital A.
Related: Balaji’s Network School turns to Kazakhstan amid Malaysia setback
items.title: Malaysia central bank launches DLT platform for tokenized bonds

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
路透社：三星、SK海力士升级中国工厂，以应对长江存储竞争

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 21 日，据路透社报道，三星电子与 SK 海力士正在升级其中国工厂，计划生产层数更高的 NAND 闪存芯片，以应对中国竞争对手长江存储的快速发展，并满足人工智能领域不断增长的存储需求。两家公司均向路透社确认正在进行相关升级，并称相关工作与美国方面保持密切沟通，但未披露具体生产计划。

三星计划将其位于中国西安的工厂升级为生产 286 层 V9 NAND 闪存芯片。该工厂目前主要生产约 200 层的芯片，占三星全球 NAND 产量的约 40%。据知情人士透露，三星内部将这一项目称为「Monami」，目标是在 2026 年 12 月实现每月 5000 片晶圆的产量，并于 2027 年 12 月将月产量提升至 4 万片。

三星表示，此次升级旨在满足包括美国客户在内的全球客户需求，不涉及扩大产能或新建制造设施。SK 海力士则计划将其位于中国大连的工厂升级为生产 240 层及以上的 NAND 产品，目前该厂生产的产品约为 192 层。据知情人士透露，该公司已获准在大连生产最高 240 层的芯片，并可能向美国政府申请在当地开展 300 层以上芯片的研发，为未来在美国生产相关产品奠定基础。

SK 海力士还正与特朗普政府讨论在美国新建 NAND 工厂的计划。报道指出，美国自 2022 年起对部分芯片制造设备实施出口管制，三星和 SK 海力士若要在中国工厂安装美国制造的设备，需要每年申请许可证。美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）此前表示，计划允许两家公司继续运营现有中国工厂，但不打算批准扩大产能或升级技术的申请。路透社尚无法确认两家公司为此次升级所需的设备出口许可获得了何种程度的批准。

与此同时，长江存储在中国 NAND 市场的份额持续上升。研究机构 Omdia 数据显示，长江存储 2026 年第二季度在中国 NAND 市场的份额达到 38.5%，高于 2025 年全年的 28%，并超过三星。同期，三星市场份额从 36% 降至 33.5%，SK 海力士则从 20% 降至 17%。长江存储目前主要生产 160 层和 232 层产品，也已少量生产 294 层芯片，并计划推出 300 层以上产品。目前，三星在中国以外市场销售最高 286 层的 NAND 芯片，并于今年 8 月展示了超过 400 层的原型产品；SK 海力士则销售最高 321 层的 NAND 芯片。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372917

items.author: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng
items.content:
Tech giants rush to block 8 eMudhra certs that could enable fake sites
A private key generation flaw allowed anyone to guess them and forge HTTPS certificates for any website.
Tech giants have deployed emergency blocks against eight vulnerable digital certificates that could allow attackers to impersonate legitimate websites.
By Tuesday, browser developers and other major technology companies had deployed protections against eight intermediate certificates issued by India-based certificate authority eMudhra Limited after discovering that their private keys were insufficiently secure.
Mozilla cryptography engineer Dennis Jackson wrote in an incident report that Mozilla independently recovered the private keys when it first received notice of the flaw on Saturday, confirming that the key-generation process was “flawed” and “trivial to exploit.”
An attacker who intercepts a user’s connection could use fraudulent certificates to impersonate a legitimate website and potentially read or alter the information exchanged, according to Mozilla.
While many companies quickly blocked the affected certificates, the threat remains for applications and systems that don’t receive those blocks automatically.
In a blog post on Tuesday, Mozilla Firefox’s security team said it received the report on Saturday and responded by blocking the affected certificates in Firefox using OneCRL, which it completed the same day. It then released an update for its browser on Desktop and Android, protecting users with custom settings that prevented them from receiving the OneCRL update.
Cloudflare said it became aware of the report on Monday and released updates for its Cloudflare One and WARP Clients and Cloudflare Tunnel on Tuesday, alongside mitigations across its services.
Jackson said that the certificates have also been blocked in Chrome since Saturday, on Apple devices since Monday and on Microsoft platforms since Tuesday.
“The issue was responsibly disclosed to downstream trust stores on the 19th of October. Many have already released updates or are in the process of releasing updates,” he said.
Related: Hugging Face hack exposes the open-weight AI cybersecurity paradox
Jackson said there is no evidence that Firefox, Chrome, Edge and Safari have been attacked this way, as there were no entries in the certificate transparency logs for the intermediate certificates since April 2025.
“However, many clients outside of the browser ecosystem do not enforce Certificate Transparency. We do not know if attackers exploited the flawed key generation to target these clients,” he said.
The incident recalls a breach of DigiNotar in 2011, a major cyberattack where hackers compromised the Dutch certificate authority, issuing 531 fraudulent SSL certificates.
The rogue certificates allowed threat actors to pose as Google and spy on approximately 300,000 Iranian Gmail accounts.

items.title: Tech giants rush to block 8 eMudhra certs that could enable fake sites

items.content:
OpenAI 28天产品冲刺Day16：Codex和Work缓存永久保留，API延长至12小时

动察 Beating AI 快讯，OpenAI 产品与平台主管 Thibault Sottiaux 公布 28 天产品冲刺的 Day 16。这次重点解决 Agent 长时间运行时的上下文缓存问题。对于已登录的 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 用户，OpenAI 宣布永久保留提示词缓存。即使隔了几个小时才继续工作，或者重新打开旧会话，也能保证命中缓存，不再因为长时间暂停而失去缓存复用的好处。

API 也同步升级。OpenAI 将 Responses API 的可选缓存时长从默认 30 分钟扩展至 12 小时。开发者可以长期缓存系统指令、工具定义和常用上下文，让 Agent 隔几个小时再执行任务时，仍能复用之前的计算结果。两种时长还能混合使用，固定指令保留 12 小时，新对话内容只缓存 30 分钟。

不过，API 延长缓存需要付出额外成本。12 小时缓存的首次写入价格为普通输入的 2.5 倍，是默认 30 分钟缓存的两倍。后续命中缓存时，多数新模型的输入价格降低 90%，GPT-6.1 Sol 则降低 95%。因此，长缓存更适合反复调用相同上下文的 Agent，而非只执行一次的短任务。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372912

items.content:
Solana将于周三启动Alpenglow升级，交易最终确认时间有望缩短至150毫秒

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 21 日，Solana 将于 10 月 21 日启动 Alpenglow 升级，这是该网络自 2020 年以来最大规模的底层改造之一。此次升级将替换现有验证者投票机制，目标是将交易最终确认时间从目前约 6 秒缩短至 150 毫秒，速度提升约 40 倍。

升级的核心是将验证者投票从链上转移至链下，并将投票整合为证书，使交易能够在一至两轮共识中完成最终确认。如果主网运行达到预期，Solana 交易确认速度将接近信用卡支付或中心化交易平台的体验，有助于改善迷因币交易、稳定币支付及链上交易平台的使用体验。此次升级还将降低验证者成本。

目前，验证者每天约需支付 2 枚 SOL 的投票费用。升级后，投票费用将被取消，改为按纪元收取固定的验证者准入费用，每个约 24 小时的纪元收费 0.8 枚 SOL，预计成本降低约 60%。不过，升级测试过程并非一帆风顺。据 Galaxy Digital 介绍，自测试网络于 5 月初启动以来，测试网络曾被清空并从头重启 6 次，其中一次迁移尝试导致整个测试网络迁移失败，随后回滚。之后的迁移最终成功，为此次主网上线铺平了道路。

上述问题均发生在测试网络中，未涉及真实资金风险。根据公告，升级计划于周三第 1064 号纪元开始时启动，并在经过 5000 个槽位的过渡阶段后，于第 459,653,000 号槽位完成切换。

Dragonfly合伙人Haseeb Qureshi否认Polymarket CEO挪用公司资金

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 21 日，Dragonfly 管理合伙人、Polymarket 早期投资人 Haseeb Qureshi 发文称，有关 Polymarket CEO Shayne Coplan 被抓到使用公司资金支付私人飞机航班等费用的说法「完全是胡说八道」，是一篇毫无根据的抹黑报道。

Haseeb 表示，Shayne 创立 Polymarket 时年仅 21 岁，当时没有领取薪水，曾在公寓里经营公司，生活拮据。Dragonfly 是最早向其提供投资条款的机构之一，甚至曾提出向 Shayne 个人提供贷款。Shayne 对每一笔支出都进行了披露，相关费用折算成年化金额约相当于一名软件工程师的薪资，其中包括的航班费用也没有涉及私人出行。

Haseeb 还强调，Shayne 是主动启动会计核算和退款流程的，并非被投资人发现后才被要求退款。最终，他已将相关款项全额偿还给公司，之后开始像其他员工一样正常领取薪水。Haseeb 将此事定性为会计处理问题，而非诚信问题，并表示 Dragonfly 对 Shayne 及其领导能力仍充满信心。他指出，Polymarket 已从一家规模较小的初创公司成长为美国增长最快、影响力最大的消费品牌之一，并呼吁外界停止传播相关负面消息。

items.content:
阿里云整合AI搜索业务：CleverSee同时瞄准公网、行业和企业内部数据

动察 Beating AI 快讯，阿里云将原 IQS 信息查询服务与 CleverSee 合并，统一升级为 CleverSee（开析）AI 搜索服务。官方记录显示，整合于 9 月 18 日完成，两套产品统一使用新品牌和控制台，同期推出新版联网搜索 API 和联网问答 Agent。

CleverSee 主要面向企业和 AI Agent，试图将公开互联网、行业专业数据和企业内部资料的检索能力整合到同一产品体系中。

CleverSee 按信息来源分为三大板块：

1. 联网搜问负责检索公开互联网，返回网页摘要、正文等内容，也能结合大模型进行多轮搜索和推理，直接生成附带来源引用的答案。

2. 垂域搜问则提供结构化的行业数据。例如，利用高德地图数据查询周边酒店、餐厅的地址、距离和评分，或通过医疗问答、健康图谱获取专业知识及参考来源。Agent 可以直接使用相关字段，省去自行抓取网页、提取信息的步骤。

3. 企业搜问面向企业内部的文档、图片、音视频等私有资料。按照阿里云公布的方案，系统可以处理和检索不同格式的数据，并将内部知识与公网实时信息结合。例如，企业员工查询业务流程时，AI 可以同时参考内部操作规范和外部公开资料。该板块目前仍处于内测阶段。

价格方面，CleverSee 国内联网搜索极速版每千次调用 8 元，智能版 18 元；能够在搜索后直接生成答案的联网问答 Agent Lite 版每千次调用 18 元。

阿里云此前还通过 OpenSearch AI 搜索开放平台提供联网搜索，CleverSee 则整合了原 IQS 体系，两者属于不同产品线，采用独立的 API 和计费方案。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372906

items.ai_reason: A genuine, newly disclosed PKI trust failure: 8 private keys of Indian CA eMudhra were trivially recoverable because they used weak integers (4, 56, 237) instead of random values, allowing certificate forgery and MITM impersonation of any trusted site. Remediation is concrete and cross-vendor — Mozilla and Chrome blocked the keys on Oct 17, Apple on Oct 19, Microsoft on Oct 20, and eMudhra revoked the certificates. The crypto transmission path is real but indirect (trading bots, exchange API clients, wallet backends that fail to check revocation), and there are no public reports of crypto user exploitation, which keeps it below systemic-incident level. Scored 7.0 rather than higher because blast radius is one mid-sized CA with fast containment, not a widespread trust-store compromise.
items.ai_summary: India's eMudhra CA had all 8 of its private keys cracked in under a second because they were weak non-random integers, prompting Chrome, Mozilla, Apple and Microsoft to block the certificates and eMudhra to revoke them, with potential knock-on risk for trading bots, exchange API connections and wallet backends that skip revocation checks.
items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
印度数字证书机构eMudhra旗下8个私钥遭破解，浏览器及软件厂商紧急修复

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 21 日，印度数字证书颁发机构 eMudhra 的 8 个私钥因安全强度不足遭研究人员破解，攻击者可能利用相关密钥伪造数字证书、冒充可信网站，并拦截或篡改用户通信数据。

据研究人员披露，eMudhra 使用了 4、56、237 等简单整数作为私钥，而非高强度随机数，导致全部 8 个私钥可在不到一秒内被恢复。漏洞于 10 月 17 日被报告后，Mozilla 和 Chrome 当天采取封禁措施，苹果和微软分别于 10 月 19 日、20 日跟进，eMudhra 也已撤销相关证书。

此外，该漏洞还可能影响加密货币交易机器人、交易平台 API 连接及钱包后端等系统，尤其是未及时验证证书撤销状态的软件。目前尚无利用该漏洞攻击加密货币用户的公开报告。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372904

日本央行前高管预计未来每三个月加息一次

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 21 日，日本央行前执行董事前田荣治表示，日本央行可能会继续每隔三个月加息一次，以控制通胀偏离其物价稳定目标的风险。前田荣治说道：「我预计下一次加息将在 12 月，之后可能在明年 3 月或 4 月再次加息。目前，加息节奏已加快至大约每三个月一次，我认为这是合适的。」这一判断也大体符合市场预期。

前田表示，不完全排除日本央行未来在连续召开的货币政策会议上接连加息的可能性，例如日元大幅贬值时就可能出现这种情况。但他认为目前看来这种可能性不大。前田表示：「如果日本央行连续两次会议都宣布加息，市场可能会越来越倾向于预期下一次会议还会继续加息，这将带来相当大的风险。因此，日本央行有理由避免在连续召开的会议上加息。」(金十)

韩股个股ETP上市两个半月致散户亏损超6万亿韩元

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 21 日，据韩联社报道，单只股票交易所交易产品（ETP，包括 ETN）上市约两个半月后，个人投资者累计亏损超过 6 万亿韩元。40 多岁群体亏损总额最高，70 岁及以上群体户均亏损最高。

据金融监督院提交给国会议员朴成勋的资料，2026 年 5 月 27 日至 8 月 14 日，10 家证券公司中至少交易过一次单只股票 ETP 的账户，总亏损为 6.313 万亿韩元，包括 2.3242 万亿韩元已实现亏损和 3.9888 万亿韩元持仓估值亏损。

40 多岁投资者约 16.52 万个账户亏损 2.053 万亿韩元；50 多岁和 30 多岁群体分别亏损 1.8655 万亿和 1.0912 万亿韩元。70 岁及以上群体约 9800 个账户户均亏损 2994 万韩元，是整体户均亏损的 2.6 倍；60 多岁群体户均亏损约 1321 万韩元。

7 月底至 8 月 14 日，已实现亏损增加 3604 亿韩元，持仓估值亏损减少 507 亿韩元，总亏损扩大 3097 亿韩元。报道指出，这可能与投资者卖出亏损产品有关，但股价波动和新增交易也会影响统计；仅凭金融监督院资料无法确认卖出原因或是否发生强制平仓。

items.content:
Flowtica获数千万元融资：手机背面贴块墨水屏，开会直接生成待办

动察 Beating AI 快讯，AI 硬件公司 Flowtica 完成数千万元人民币新一轮融资，由祥峰资本领投，源码资本、五源资本及清水湾基金等老股东跟投。

与此同时，公司在今年 9 月 IFA 展会上亮相的 AI 墨水屏 Verso 已开启定金预订，计划 12 月初交付首批产品。

Verso 是一块厚 6.5 毫米的磁吸墨水屏，可以贴在手机背面。按照官方介绍，开会时按一下就能录音，实时转写并提炼重点，会议还没结束，待办事项就能显示在屏幕上。用户可以按键标记重要发言，也能直接向 AI 提问，比如查找上次与客户讨论的内容，或者生成会后跟进邮件草稿。

相比 PLAUD Note Pro 等 AI 录音卡，Verso 的主要区别不是录音总结，而是把会议纪要、日程和待办直接放在硬件屏幕上，不用反复打开手机 App。它还会在会前调出过去的沟通记录，提醒用户有哪些事情尚未解决。不过，Flowtica 放弃了全天候监听设计，用户必须手动开启录音，录音指示灯也无法关闭。

Verso 在美国的预订价为 199 美元，常规标价 299 美元。预订需先付 10 美元定金，11 月 17 日起支付尾款。设备附赠 3 个月无限量 AI 套餐，后续使用无限量服务仍需另外付费。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372901

路透社：100位经济学家一致预计美联储12月再加息

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 21 日，路透社最新调查显示，市场对美联储利率前景的判断正在发生明显变化。10 月加息预期有所降温，但 12 月再次加息已成为受访经济学家的共同判断，反映出强劲的经济增长和顽固的通胀压力正重新影响货币政策预期。

在 10 月 16 日至 20 日进行的调查中，94 位经济学家预计，美联储将在 10 月 27 日至 28 日的会议上将联邦基金利率维持在 3.75% 至 4.00% 的区间。这一判断与市场定价反映的预期一致，而此次会议距离美国 11 月中期选举仅有数日。

相比之下，12 月的利率预期出现急剧转变。上个月的调查中，不足半数经济学家预计美联储将在 12 月加息；本次调查中，100 位受访者全部预计届时将再次加息。

前豆包PC端负责人齐俊元创办的Today AI累计融资超2亿美元：腾讯、蚂蚁、红杉入局，已开始自训模型

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Teambition 创始人、前豆包 PC 端负责人齐俊元创办的 Today AI 宣布，累计完成超过 2 亿美元融资。投资方包括 IDG 资本、腾讯、五源资本、蚂蚁集团、红杉中国、传音控股、同歌创投和上海交大菡源资产。

Today 原本计划先做软件，再开发硬件，最后训练自己的模型。如今研发顺序已经调整为软件与模型同步推进，目前已有早期模型实验版本。原因是现有大模型的编程能力越来越强，但与用户自然交流、理解个人偏好的能力并未同步改善。Today 希望专门训练适合个人助理的模型，硬件则计划与合作伙伴共同开发。

不过，产品距离团队设想的个人 AI 助理仍有差距。在此前接受《晚点》采访时，Today 团队坦言，目前系统主动了解和适应用户的能力还只有「二三十分」。极客公园的十天试用也发现，Today 能用 15 分钟完成游戏 Mod 汉化，却因为连续给出错误的安装建议，让记者反复折腾了一个小时。如何判断任务轻重、何时主动行动，仍是这类个人 Agent 需要解决的问题。

Bitunix分析师：伊朗僵局推升能源风险，美联储升息预期与美国选举压力交织

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 21 日，美国面临的政策难题已不只在通胀，更涉及中东能源供应与国内政治压力。伊朗拒绝在美方满足七项条件前恢复谈判，要求解除港口封锁与石油制裁、停止区域敌对行动，并坚持对霍尔木兹海峡保有控制权。德黑兰有意将僵局延续至美国 11 月 3 日中期选举前，藉高油价与航运受阻增加白宫的政治成本。与此同时，特朗普特使巴拉克表示，美国不再无限承担海湾安全担保责任；即使美军仍在增派力量，这也意味着区域盟友可能需要分担更多防务责任，能源供应风险因而不只是短期冲突溢价，也牵涉中东安全秩序的长期变化。

利率预期同样转趋鹰派。路透调查中，94 位经济学家预计美联储 10 月 27 日至 28 日会议维持利率于 3.75% 至 4.00%，但 100 位受访者全数预期 12 月再升息，近六成更预估利率可能升至 4.00% 至 4.25%。美国经济成长仍具韧性，AI 投资支撑需求，而能源与关税成本又可能延长通胀回落所需时间，暂停升息因此不等于政策转向宽松。特朗普提出 80 亿美元农民援助及现金补贴构想，虽试图缓解生活成本压力，却也面临财政支出与需求刺激可能牵动通胀的质疑。

然而，股市信号并非全面悲观。标普 500 指数仍仅较历史高点低约 1.6%，费城半导体指数却自 10 月 6 日以来下跌约 14%；高盛与富国银行的逆向买进信号，反映市场情绪已明显降温，但不代表风险解除。后续焦点在于能源冲击是否持续推高物价、美联储是否因此维持更高利率，以及 AI 资本支出能否转化为可持续获利。若这些条件同时承压，市场可能面临的将不只是估值修正，而是成长预期、融资成本与资金配置的再平衡。

items.content:
Mistral发布Voxtral 3：把语音识别、推理和工具调用接成实时Agent

动察 Beating AI 快讯，法国 AI 公司 Mistral 发布 Voxtral 3，包括三款语音转录模型、一款语音合成模型，以及完整的 Voice Agent SDK。

官方演示中，一名用户用英语要求预约皮肤科医生。AI 读取法语转诊信，调用系统查询空闲时段，完成预约后再用英语确认。整个过程通过实时语音对话完成。

Voxtral 3 并不是一款包办所有任务的端到端语音大模型。它采用模块化设计：转录模型负责识别语音、判断用户何时说完，Mistral Small 等通用大模型负责推理和调用工具，语音合成模型负责回答。基于 LiveKit 的 SDK 将这些环节串成实时流水线，支持电话和网页通话，也允许用户随时打断。Mistral 宣称单轮交互延迟不到 1 秒。开发者还能单独替换推理模型或语音模型。

转录支持的语言从上一代 13 种扩展至 50 多种，语音合成支持 35 种以上语言和 50 多种方言。在 Artificial Analysis 的独立非实时转录测试中，Voxtral Small Transcribe 3 词错误率为 2.1%，排名第三，仅次于阿里巴巴和微软的模型。语音合成则排名第 13。

API 实时转录每分钟收费 0.008 美元，语音合成每百万字符 13 美元。企业还可联系 Mistral，在自有服务器或私有云中部署。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372884

火币HTX首席分析师Cloud：议息前比特币大概率延续震荡，8万美元下沿或先受考验

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 21 日，比特币近两周困在 8 万至 8.4 万美元区间，对此火币 HTX 首席分析师 Cloud 认为，其本质是两股力量互相抵消：ETF 连续两周净流出，而交易所持仓持续外流、长期持有者只是温和兑现。在美联储议息的前一周，比特币大概率继续区间等待，CME 只给 10 月加息 16% 的定价，经济学家却普遍认为接近五五开，这种定价与分歧的落差会让资金不敢提前押注。

若提前选择方向，向下测试的可能性略高：资金费率仍处高位，期权偏度持续偏向认沽，说明多头尚未出清，下行保护需求仍在增加。不过 8 万美元下方过去一个月多次形成有效支撑，向下突破更可能是假突破。

突破的确认信号分为两组，向上需日线收于 8.42 万美元上方、ETF 连续三日累计净流入超 5 亿美元，且资金费率不超过 15%；向下则需失守 7.98 万美元、单周 ETF 流出再超 5 亿美元，同时交易所资金转为净流入。真正的方向源仍是北京时间 10 月 29 日凌晨公布的议息决议与 12 月近 89% 的加息定价。

动察 Beating AI 快讯，OpenAI 宣布收购成立 4 年的生物技术公司 Orchestra Bio，将其团队和技术整合进生命科学平台 Rosalind。

OpenAI 今年 4 月推出了专门处理生物学、化学问题的 GPT-Rosalind，随后配套推出科研工作台。此次收购将补上药物研发的项目管理环节，让 AI 从分析实验数据，进一步参与后续研发流程。

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 21 日，据英国《每日邮报》报道，一名协助涉案金额达 55 亿英镑的诈骗犯洗钱的人员，已向英国政府交还 560 万英镑。48 岁的 Hok Seng Ling 因承认参与英国历史上涉案金额最大的洗钱案，被法院责令交出上述资金。

他曾担任钱志敏的「管家」。后者策划了一项庞氏骗局，在 2014 年至 2017 年间诈骗超过 12.8 万名中国投资者，随后将诈骗所得转换为比特币，并逃往英国。马来西亚籍人士 Ling 居住在英国德比郡马特洛克。他协助这位「比特币女王」洗白非法所得，并通过预订 Airbnb 住宿、安排协助人员等方式，帮助其躲避英国警方追查。

去年 11 月，Ling 在伦敦南华克刑事法院承认洗钱相关罪行后，被判处 4 年 11 个月监禁。此后，法官对其作出没收财产令，要求其交出 5,603,305 英镑。其中大部分资金来自他被捕时查获的加密货币。上述款项目前已全部追回，此外还追回了 1990 英镑利息。

[paczki]: As someone who actively goes out of my way to stick to writing vanilla HTML/CSS/JS as much as possible, it's honestly hard to explain to people who only write within frameworks how good it's gotten. Use the proper tool for the job, of course, but it sparks joy!

[PennRobotics]: Corners and borders have been a pain since the beginning of GeoCities. I do wish fancy corners would go away---to the point that I actively make this happen with a global Stylus rule setting border-radius to 0. Look: Three of these 10 "improvements" deal with corner shaping, and two more will inevitably need extending, as I imagine frontend devs get around to, "GPT make reading-flow responsively round only the outside corners," and, "Claude how to squircle the individ...

[fodkodrasz]: Wow even more fancy border styles! Infinite complexity for useless eyecandy. Date pickers are still barely working, last time i needed to build a touch optimized interface (gloves, industrial setting) with date picker, time picker, and numeric up/down style input fields it needed custom components and js... But who needs these, when we can have bezel and whatnot... Who needs ways to reliably trigger the display of the touch platform-native keyboard, to be notified if it is displayed and ...

[thisislife2]: "Functions in CSS"  - Bah! That's all we need to make CSS even more convoluted - make it compete with Javascript now ... All these feature creep is just to make sure nobody else can create another browser engine.

[CharlesW]: Since I’m in before the negativity: I love CSS! For whatever reason, it’s always made sense to me. I have great respect for everyone with the tenacity to push on improvements that might take 5-10 years to be in common use, if at all.

17岁Kimi前研究员陈广宇被曝加入前谷歌首席科学家Jeff Dean创业团队，新公司正寻求500亿美元估值

动察 Beating AI 快讯，17 岁的 Kimi 前研究员陈广宇，被曝加入 Google 前首席科学家 Jeff Dean 创办的 AI 公司 Discovery Loop。

10 月 20 日，专门追踪硅谷 AI 人才流动的匿名账号 Arfur Grok 披露了这一消息。陈广宇 5 天前刚宣布离开 Kimi，此前曾参与 Attention Residuals 架构研究及 Kimi K3 研发。

Discovery Loop 今年 8 月才成立，由 Jeff Dean 等四位 Google 老将共同创办。公司计划让 AI 自主提出研究假设、并行运行数千项实验，再根据结果不断调整方案。最初聚焦 AI 模型研发，未来扩展到医疗、材料和能源等领域。谷歌母公司 Alphabet 也是其创始投资方之一。

公司尚未推出公开产品，估值却已十分惊人。《商业内幕》9 月报道称，Discovery Loop 正寻求以约 500 亿美元估值融资。

此前，硅谷投资人 Deedy Das 曾提到一名 17 岁少年获得 5 份百万美元级 AI 工作邀约。外界猜测是陈广宇，但 Deedy 从未公开对方身份。

items.content:
Musk says SpaceX-Tesla merger a ‘good idea’ as AI revenue jumps ninefold
A merger would bring Tesla into the same corporate group as Grok developer SpaceXAI and social media platform X.
Elon Musk said he likes the idea of merging Tesla with SpaceX in a potential move that would create a roughly $3.5 trillion technology giant combining AI, space exploration and electric vehicle manufacturing.
“Do I think it would be a good idea? Yes,” Musk said of the potential merger during a SpaceX Q3 earnings call on Tuesday.
Musk said that both SpaceX and Tesla have formed special committees of independent directors to discuss the idea at the request of shareholders, though he isn’t able to take part in the discussions due to being a conflicted party.
A merger would bring Tesla into the same corporate group as Grok developer SpaceXAI (formerly xAI) and social media platform X, which SpaceX acquired in February. The talks also come as SpaceX’s AI business became its largest revenue segment in Q3, underscoring how central artificial intelligence has become to Musk’s expanding technology empire.
“There’s a lot to be gained from cooperating on developing superintelligence software, chip design, the Terafab, obviously, robotics, mass to orbit with the Starmind constellation. Connectivity,” said Musk.
However, Musk tempered expectations of whether a merger will ultimately come through.
“Some people out there assume that a SpaceX and Tesla merger is a certainty, and I think that would be overstating it,” he said, adding that the special committees have not reached agreement on terms of any transaction and there is no guarantee that they will.
“At the end of the day, the shareholders have to be supportive of this and particularly on Tesla’s side we’ll need a 50% vote of all shares, not just those who vote, but of all shareholders. And that’s quite a high hurdle to try to achieve.”
SpaceX Q3 earnings show huge AI revenue gains
Musk’s comments followed SpaceX’s third-quarter earnings report, which showed revenue rising 161% year over year to $14.6 billion, driven largely by its “Super Intelligence” AI segment.
SpaceX’s Super Intelligence segment generated $7.6 billion in third-quarter revenue, an 830% increase from a year earlier, making it the company’s largest revenue contributor.
Related: Crypto Biz: SpaceX fuels tokenization’s next boom
SpaceX said the growth was driven by the activation of new cloud services agreements, the acquisition of Cursor and increased adoption of its agentic AI model Grok across enterprise and consumers.
Combined Bitcoin holdings would exceed 30,000 BTC
A Tesla–SpaceX merger could also bring two sizable corporate Bitcoin treasuries under one roof. SpaceX reported holding 18,712 Bitcoin as of June 30, while Tesla held 11,509 BTC on the same date, according to their respective quarterly filings.
Based on those disclosures, a combined company would hold 30,221 BTC, which would make it the sixth-largest public Bitcoin treasury company, beating crypto exchange Bullish.

SpaceX电话会：马斯克称明年算力规模有望超13吉瓦，ARR上看1万亿

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 21 日，SpaceX 公布 2026 年第三季度业绩，截至 9 月，公司营收同比增长 161% 至 145.8 亿美元，较分析师预期的约 128 亿美元高出逾 10%；净利润由去年同期亏损 11 亿美元转为盈利 44 亿美元，调整后 EBITDA 同比增长 306% 至 88 亿美元。其中，超级智能云服务业务单季营收达 76 亿美元，环比增加 50 亿美元。电话会上，管理层表示，当前 AI 算力需求旺盛，新部署算力的投资回收期已缩短至一年以内，马斯克甚至预计，随着需求和定价持续走强，回收周期未来可能进一步缩短至 6 个月。

在 AI 算力扩张方面，马斯克表示，截至 2026 年底，SpaceX 预计将有 2.5 至 3GW 算力投入运行，并有信心在 2027 年新增 10GW 算力；若到 2027 年底上线算力不足 13GW，他将感到意外。为避免电力和冷却成为扩张瓶颈，公司计划 2027 年额外增加 20GW 电力供应及冷却基础设施，并持续部署英伟达 GPU，预计今年剩余时间每月上线约 20 万颗 GB300，明年则将主要部署 Vera Rubin 计算系统。此外，公司计划在 2027 年第二季度末部署由 44 万台 Vera Rubin 计算机组成的训练集群，用于支持 Grok 大模型。马斯克还预计，SpaceX 年度经常性收入（ARR）到 2027 年底有望达到 5000 亿至 1 万亿美元。Grok Bot（智能体助手）于 8 月上线，截至本月初已拥有 80 万付费周活跃用户，较上月翻倍增长。B2B 是增长最快的业务类别，越来越多的企业将 Grok Bot 作为销售、市场、IT 和工程领域的效能倍增器，将其视为应对复杂端到端工作流的全天候团队成员。

马斯克称，当前超级智能发展的主要制约因素已从芯片转向电力、冷却及配套基础设施。SpaceX 将航天领域的部分顶尖团队投入地面算力基础设施建设，并称其部署电力和冷却设施的速度有望超过其他所有厂商的总和。公司预计第四季度资本开支将达到 350 亿至 400 亿美元，并倾向于按现货市场费率签订短期算力租赁合同，以把握当前供不应求的市场环境。马斯克表示，超大规模云服务商及数十家小型企业均在争相租用其算力，部分 GPU 和其他计算资源在市场上难以获得。

在航天及星链业务方面，马斯克表示，星舰第 15 次试飞计划于下月进行，目标是首次尝试在轨道任务中同时回收助推器和飞船；公司预计星舰明年上半年实现每周飞行，下半年提升至每周两次或更高频率。马斯克还称，V3 星链卫星单次部署可提供相当于 10 次猎鹰 9 号发射的带宽，预计三年内星链网络带宽将达到当前水平的约 100 倍，以满足 AI 智能体发展带来的通信需求。星链移动直连手机业务月活用户已超过 2200 万，航空终端产量预计在今年年底前翻番，企业及政府业务收入未来均有望超过消费者业务收入。此外，SpaceX 计划于 2027 年 5 月至 6 月在奥斯汀实验室制造首款功能性测试芯片，并争取于 2028 年第三季度在 TerraFab 主厂区实现量产。

关于 SpaceX 与特斯拉合并的可能性，马斯克确认，两家公司已成立特别委员会讨论相关方案，但目前尚未就合并条款达成一致。他认为，合并可能具有较大价值，但强调交易远未板上钉钉，仍存在不确定性，且必须获得股东批准。马斯克表示，由于自身存在利益冲突，他没有参与相关委员会的讨论；按照其说法，特斯拉方面需要获得全体股东中 50% 的支持，而不仅仅是参与投票股东的多数支持。

OKX-ICE联席主席：企业反对代币化股票计划是「正常反应」，符合预期

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 21 日，OKX-ICE 合资企业联席主席 Andrew Cuomo 表示，发行方反对代币化股票交易是「正常反应」，并称企业采取观望态度符合预期。越来越多企业拒绝其股票参与代币化交易，是测试新市场结构过程中可以预见的情况。OKX-ICE 合资企业联席主席 Andrew Cuomo 在微软、Alphabet 和高盛加入反对行列后作出上述表态。

Cuomo 同时担任 OKX 董事会成员，曾任纽约州州长。他周二在一次媒体电话会议上表示：「这是非常正常的反应。该模式旨在赋予企业自主决定是否参与的权利，企业可以选择加入或退出。」他补充称：「我们一直预料到，由于这是一项具有重大影响、颠覆性的变革，许多企业会选择观望，等待事态发展，而不是成为首批参与者。」

周一公布的一份公开通知显示，共有 16 家企业反对其股票的代币化版本在 OKXICE 平台交易。该平台由加密货币交易平台 OKX 与纽约证券交易平台母公司洲际交易平台（ICE）计划共同推出。新增披露的 7 家反对企业包括微软、Alphabet、高盛、高通、卡特彼勒、麦当劳和西部数据。此前，博通、威瑞森和联合健康集团等企业也已提出反对。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng
items.content:
Qubic restarts blockchain, opens recovery claims after $1.4M hack
The network’s validators approved a recovery plan and opened claims until May 1, 2027.
Layer-1 blockchain Qubic has restarted its network and launched a recovery process after a wallet seed vulnerability allowed an attacker to drain roughly $1.4 million in QU tokens from 1,404 accounts, according to the project’s latest update.
Qubic’s blockchain explorer shows the network resumed processing ticks 8:00 pm on Oct. 19, advancing beyond tick 85,371,949, where it was halted on Sunday.
Qubic said its network validators, known as Computors, had approved a recovery plan and that the project had launched a claims platform for affected wallet holders.
Affected users can check their address and submit a claim through Qubic’s reclaim platform. Affected users have until May 1, 2027, to submit claims, according to Qubic.
The network was halted Sunday to prevent further movement of stolen funds after attackers exploited predictable wallet seeds generated by vulnerable wallet software.
The vulnerability affected wallet seeds generated using Qubic’s web wallet on certain Apple devices and browsers, where an insecure random-number generator could produce predictable seeds. Qubic on Sunday said it had fixed the seed-generation flaw in the latest version of its web wallet.
“If you created your wallet with the Qubic web wallet before version 4.26.4 (released 19 October), treat it as insecure, even if your funds were never touched,” said Qubic on Tuesday.
“Update to web wallet 4.26.4 or later, then create a new wallet,” said the team. “Move your funds to the new wallet as soon as you can, and never use the old one again.”
Related: Qubic freezes chain after attacker drains 1.4K wallets with weak seeds

华尔街机构敦促美SEC修改《加密资产监管条例》，公众意见征集结束

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 21 日，随着美国证券交易委员会（SEC）针对拟议《加密资产监管条例》的公众意见征集即将结束，数字资产企业、华尔街机构及行业倡议组织纷纷提出各自的主张，希望影响该机构对金融创新未来的监管方向。

SEC 对拟议《加密资产监管条例》的意见征集于周二截止，目前已收到 100 多份意见。该规则旨在为涉及数字资产的投资活动提供合规路径，使符合条件的发行活动能够豁免部分证券法要求。其中包括一项「初创企业豁免」，允许规模不超过 500 万美元的发行免于遵守注册规定；此外，提案还包括一项「融资豁免」，允许发行方在一年内开展规模不超过 7500 万美元的发行活动。

Hyperliquid 政策中心（HPC）在提交给 SEC 的意见信中敦促该机构采纳《加密资产监管条例》，但同时指出，需要调整有关空投的处理方式。该中心要求 SEC 将此前的相关表述正式纳入规则，即如果空投接收者无需付出任何对价便可获得资产，则不构成资金投入，因此相关资产不属于证券。HPC 还认为，SEC 提议的安全港机制适用范围过于有限。

加密政治行动委员会进入美国中期选举冲刺阶段，账面资金逾9500万美元

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 21 日，据 Politico 报道，根据周二公布的联邦竞选财务申报文件，加密货币行业主要超级政治行动委员会（Super PAC）组织截至 9 月底仍持有超过 9500 万美元资金。

这笔资金为该政治行动委员会网络提供了充足的资金支持，使其能够在 2026 年美国中期选举前的最后阶段继续支持加密行业的盟友。该组织名为 Fairshake，主要资金来源包括加密货币公司 Coinbase、Ripple，以及风险投资巨头 Andreessen Horowitz。目前尚不清楚，该组织是否会动用全部剩余资金，还是会保留部分资金用于 2028 年选举周期。

Fairshake 网络由三个关联政治行动委员会组成，分别为 Fairshake、Defend American Jobs 和 Protect Progress，致力于支持两党中对加密行业持友好态度的候选人。本轮选举周期以来，该组织规模最大的一笔政治支出来自共和党阵营的 Defend American Jobs。该组织投入 4500 万美元，支持共和党参议员 Jon Husted，同时打击前参议员 Sherrod Brown。Brown 此前担任参议院银行委员会主席期间，曾对加密行业持批评态度。此外，该组织还以规模较小的资金支出，支持 32 名对加密行业持友好态度的现任众议员。

马斯克指出，双方在人工智能、芯片、机器人和通信连接等技术领域加强合作，将有很大的潜在收益。但他同时强调，合并交易并非板上钉钉。马斯克表示：「如果说这件事已经确定，那就有些言过其实了。」他还指出，交易需要获得特斯拉 50% 股东的批准，并称这是一道相当高的门槛。

items.author: Jose Antonio Lanz
items.content:
In brief
- A developer used Claude Code to disable 25 Xiaomi packages on his parents' TV, and his open-source cleanyourtv project now lists tested setups for 107 TV models from 37 brands.
- The tools use Android's built-in debugging bridge to switch apps off rather than delete them, so a restore script can undo every change.
- TV makers earn money from ads and viewing data, a practice Texas challenged in December 2025 lawsuits against Sony, Samsung, LG, Hisense and TCL.
Smart TV owners are pointing AI agents at their living-room sets and ordering them to rip out the sponsored ads, the tracking software and the sluggish home screens that manufacturers ship by default.
The trend exploded on X over the weekend, and it already has a name: vibe coding your TV.
The most-shared case involved a Xiaomi TV owned by a developer's parents. Gathin T. posted on Saturday that the set showed a sponsored ad before anyone could even reach Netflix, so he gave Claude Code the model number and let it work.
The agent found the TV on his home Wi-Fi, switched off 25 Xiaomi software packages and wrote a brand-new home screen that, as he put it, “looks like an Apple TV now lol.”
Vibe coded my parents' TV this afternoon!
It was showing a sponsored ad before you could even get to Netflix.
Gave Claude Code the model number, it found the TV on wifi, removed 25 Xiaomi packages and wrote a new launcher.
Looks like an Apple TV now lol pic.twitter.com/E5Q4A1b0yI
— Gathin (Ø,G) (@gathint) October 17, 2026
Anyone who bought a TV in the last decade likely lives with the same problem, because many sets run Automatic Content Recognition, or ACR—software that fingerprints whatever is on screen, including cable, consoles and anything plugged into an HDMI port, and reports it back so the maker can sell targeted ads. Texas sued Sony, Samsung, LG, Hisense, and TCL in December 2025, alleging their TVs can capture a screenshot of your display every 500 milliseconds, or twice a second.
Regulators have chased this since at least 2017, when Vizio paid $2.2 million to settle charges that it collected viewing data from 11 million TVs without consent. It didn't hurt the business much: Walmart bought Vizio for about $2.3 billion in 2024, and its executives singled out the TV maker's profitable, fast-growing ad business as part of the appeal.
In other words, the TV you paid for keeps making money for someone else every time you turn it on.
Vibe coding, which means describing what you want in plain language and letting an AI write and run the code, got its name from OpenAI co-founder Andrej Karpathy in 2025. Earlier this month, gamers used Claude-based agents to reverse engineer their games and do all kinds of crazy stuff like stuffing Minecraft into Elden Ring.
Claude Code, Anthropic's coding agent, is the key ingredient because it can now type and run commands on your computer. Android-based TVs come with the Android Debug Bridge, or ADB, a maintenance tool that lets a computer on the same network control the set once you unlock developer mode by clicking the “Build” number seven times in the settings menu.
The agent connects through that door, lists every installed app, and flags which ones serve ads or run telemetry, the background software that phones home with usage data.
Gathin packaged his prompt as cleanyourtv, an open-source project that switches unwanted apps off instead of deleting them, so a single restore script puts everything back. It needs no “root,” the risky process of unlocking full administrator control, and as of Tuesday it listed tested setups for 107 TV models from 37 brands and had collected 10,700 stars, GitHub's version of bookmarks. On his donation page, Gathin wrote that a few thousand people did the same to their own TVs within two days.
Others are doing more than just debloating their TVs.
Mihir Gupta replaced the 192 MB stock launcher, the app that draws your home screen, with a custom 83 MB one, while Ansub Khan said free memory on his parents' old Android TV rose about 90%. Ryan Doyle simply sent Claude his TV's product listing, asked if it could hack it, and ended up with a screensaver showing his revenue and new Stripe payments.
Saw people vibe coding their TVs. Mine had gotten unbearably slow, so I tried it.
One afternoon with Claude Code: 25 bloat apps disabled, the 192 MB stock launcher replaced with a custom 83 MB one, plus rotating wallpapers.
With AI, all you have to do is imagine! pic.twitter.com/QR6V3Au2f5
— Mihir Gupta (@0900mihir) October 18, 2026
Rod Pers went further and swapped the ads for a live 3D model of his apartment, with the lights and ceiling fan switching on in real time. Adrian Friend built a minimal interface in the animation tool Rive, and another user said he cleaned up his grandma's TV, who is now very happy with it.
jumped on the whole tv 'hacking' trend
super minimal and done in @rive_app because why not pic.twitter.com/rk53DOBfhB
— Adrian Friend (@z00med0ut) October 19, 2026
A rival project, dumbtv, targets the Amazon Fire TV and disables about 65 packages, including the ACR software, before installing a 41 KB launcher with no internet permission at all. Its pitch is blunt: “your apps, your HDMI inputs, a clock, and nothing else.”
Cleanyourtv only fully works on Android TV and Google TV sets from brands like Sony, TCL, Hisense, Philips and Xiaomi, while Samsung's Tizen and LG's webOS are different operating systems and Fire TV only allows the cleanup half.
For LG TVs, users have already made some moves, debloating their TVs, but not overhauling the interface so much like the Android TV users. That said, this is a very big plus for privacy conscious users, considering experts have been able to see how LG can secretly pinpoint its users’ location, collect voice conversations and other data even when their TVs appear to be off.
LG spyware gone and simplified the UI https://t.co/Ams81w9uKE pic.twitter.com/qmLGDURELb
— malone (@malonehedges) October 20, 2026
Not every attempt ended well, either: one user said he bricked his TV—tech slang for turning a device into an expensive paperweight—and another got stuck halfway through a Fire TV job.
Claude bricked my tv last month trying to reboot and uninstalled the os, was fun seeing that old android recovery screen on tv
— 🔻 (@jihadsinwar) October 19, 2026
The cleanyourtv “readme” file also warns that network ADB is unencrypted and, on some firmware, lets any device on the same Wi-Fi take control of the TV, so users should switch debugging off when they finish. AI agents can be tricked, too: Microsoft found this year that hidden instructions could push Claude Code into exposing credentials, a flaw Anthropic patched in May.
One X user offered a more practical warning: if you clean up your parents' TV, don't explain how, because they own a lot of other things with model numbers.
As of Tuesday, the cleanyourtv repository had been copied, or “forked,” 1,200 times and had 85 open pull requests, the proposed changes volunteers submit to an open-source project.
